terms.definition: Specifies the most energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

terms.label: energyEfficiencyScaleMin
terms.definition: Specifies the least energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

terms.label: engineDisplacement
terms.definition:
The volume swept by all of the pistons inside the cylinders of an internal combustion engine in a single movement. 

Typical unit code(s): CMQ for cubic centimeter, LTR for liters, INQ for cubic inches
* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: enginePower
terms.definition:
The power of the vehicle's engine. Typical unit code(s): KWT for kilowatt, BHP for brake horsepower, N12 for metric horsepower (PS, with 1 PS = 735,49875 W)

* Note 1: There are many different ways of measuring an engine's power. For an overview, see [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine\_power\_test\_codes](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine_power_test_codes).
* Note 2: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 3: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: engineType
terms.definition: The type of engine or engines powering the vehicle.

terms.label: entertainmentBusiness
terms.definition: A sub property of location. The entertainment business where the action occurred.

terms.label: epidemiology
terms.definition: The characteristics of associated patients, such as age, gender, race etc.

terms.label: episode
terms.definition: An episode of a TV, radio or game media within a series or season.

terms.label: episodeNumber
terms.definition: Position of the episode within an ordered group of episodes.

terms.label: episodes
terms.definition: An episode of a TV/radio series or season.

terms.label: equal
terms.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is equal to the object.

terms.label: error
terms.definition: For failed actions, more information on the cause of the failure. Consider using the Error type.

terms.label: errorCode
terms.definition: Application or platform dependant error code.

terms.label: estimatedCost
terms.definition: The estimated cost of the supply or supplies consumed when performing instructions.

terms.label: estimatedFlightDuration
terms.definition: The estimated time the flight will take.

terms.label: estimatedSalary
terms.definition: An estimated salary for a job posting or occupation, based on a variety of variables including, but not limited to industry, job title, and location. Estimated salaries are often computed by outside organizations rather than the hiring organization, who may not have committed to the estimated value.

terms.label: estimatesRiskOf
terms.definition: The condition, complication, or symptom whose risk is being estimated.

terms.label: ethicsPolicy
terms.definition: Statement about ethics policy, e.g. of a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] regarding journalistic and publishing practices, or of a [[Restaurant]], a page describing food source policies. In the case of a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], an ethicsPolicy is typically a statement describing the personal, organizational, and corporate standards of behavior expected by the organization.

terms.label: event
terms.definition: Upcoming or past event associated with this place, organization, or action.

terms.label: eventAttendanceMode
terms.definition: The eventAttendanceMode of an event indicates whether it occurs online, offline, or a mix.

terms.label: eventSchedule
terms.definition: Associates an [[Event]] with a [[Schedule]]. There are circumstances where it is preferable to share a schedule for a series of repeating events rather than data on the individual events themselves. For example, a website or application might prefer to publish a schedule for a weekly gym class rather than provide data on every event. A schedule could be processed by applications to add forthcoming events to a calendar. An [[Event]] that is associated with a [[Schedule]] using this property should not have [[startDate]] or [[endDate]] properties. These are instead defined within the associated [[Schedule]], this avoids any ambiguity for clients using the data. The property might have repeated values to specify different schedules, e.g. for different months or seasons.

terms.label: eventStatus
terms.definition: An eventStatus of an event represents its status; particularly useful when an event is cancelled or rescheduled.

terms.label: events
terms.definition: Upcoming or past events associated with this place or organization.

terms.label: evidenceLevel
terms.definition: Strength of evidence of the data used to formulate the guideline (enumerated).

terms.label: evidenceOrigin
terms.definition: Source of the data used to formulate the guidance, e.g. RCT, consensus opinion, etc.

terms.label: exampleOfWork
terms.definition: A creative work that this work is an example/instance/realization/derivation of.

terms.label: exceptDate
terms.definition: Defines a [[Date]] or [[DateTime]] during which a scheduled [[Event]] will not take place. The property allows exceptions to a [[Schedule]] to be specified. If an exception is specified as a [[DateTime]] then only the event that would have started at that specific date and time should be excluded from the schedule. If an exception is specified as a [[Date]] then any event that is scheduled for that 24 hour period should be excluded from the schedule. This allows a whole day to be excluded from the schedule without having to itemise every scheduled event.

terms.label: exchangeRateSpread
terms.definition: The difference between the price at which a broker or other intermediary buys and sells foreign currency.

terms.label: executableLibraryName
terms.definition: Library file name, e.g., mscorlib.dll, system.web.dll.

terms.label: exerciseCourse
terms.definition: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

terms.label: exercisePlan
terms.definition: A sub property of instrument. The exercise plan used on this action.

terms.label: exerciseRelatedDiet
terms.definition: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

terms.label: exerciseType
terms.definition: Type(s) of exercise or activity, such as strength training, flexibility training, aerobics, cardiac rehabilitation, etc.

terms.label: exifData
terms.definition: exif data for this object.

terms.label: expectedArrivalFrom
terms.definition: The earliest date the package may arrive.

terms.label: expectedArrivalUntil
terms.definition: The latest date the package may arrive.

terms.label: expectedPrognosis
terms.definition: The likely outcome in either the short term or long term of the medical condition.

terms.label: expectsAcceptanceOf
terms.definition: An Offer which must be accepted before the user can perform the Action. For example, the user may need to buy a movie before being able to watch it.

terms.label: experienceInPlaceOfEducation
terms.definition: Indicates whether a [[JobPosting]] will accept experience (as indicated by [[OccupationalExperienceRequirements]]) in place of its formal educational qualifications (as indicated by [[educationRequirements]]). If true, indicates that satisfying one of these requirements is sufficient.

terms.label: experienceRequirements
terms.definition: Description of skills and experience needed for the position or Occupation.

terms.label: expertConsiderations
terms.definition: Medical expert advice related to the plan.

terms.label: expires
terms.definition: Date the content expires and is no longer useful or available. For example a [[VideoObject]] or [[NewsArticle]] whose availability or relevance is time-limited, a [[ClaimReview]] fact check whose publisher wants to indicate that it may no longer be relevant (or helpful to highlight) after some date, or a [[Certification]] the validity has expired.

terms.label: expressedIn
terms.definition: Tissue, organ, biological sample, etc in which activity of this gene has been observed experimentally. For example brain, digestive system.

terms.label: extendedAddress
terms.definition: An address extension such as an apartment number, C/O or alternative name.

terms.label: familyName
terms.definition: Family name. In the U.S., the last name of a Person.

terms.label: fatContent
terms.definition: The number of grams of fat.

terms.label: faxNumber
terms.definition: The fax number.

terms.label: featureList
terms.definition: Features or modules provided by this application (and possibly required by other applications).

terms.label: feesAndCommissionsSpecification
terms.definition: Description of fees, commissions, and other terms applied either to a class of financial product, or by a financial service organization.

terms.label: fiberContent
terms.definition: The number of grams of fiber.

terms.label: fileFormat
terms.definition: Media type, typically MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml)) of the content, e.g. application/zip of a SoftwareApplication binary. In cases where a CreativeWork has several media type representations, 'encoding' can be used to indicate each MediaObject alongside particular fileFormat information. Unregistered or niche file formats can be indicated instead via the most appropriate URL, e.g. defining Web page or a Wikipedia entry.

terms.label: fileSize
terms.definition: Size of the application / package (e.g. 18MB). In the absence of a unit (MB, KB etc.), KB will be assumed.

terms.label: financialAidEligible
terms.definition: A financial aid type or program which students may use to pay for tuition or fees associated with the program.

terms.label: firstAppearance
terms.definition: Indicates the first known occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].

terms.label: firstPerformance
terms.definition: The date and place the work was first performed.

terms.label: flightDistance
terms.definition: The distance of the flight.

terms.label: flightNumber
terms.definition: The unique identifier for a flight including the airline IATA code. For example, if describing United flight 110, where the IATA code for United is 'UA', the flightNumber is 'UA110'.

terms.label: floorLevel
terms.definition: The floor level for an [[Accommodation]] in a multi-storey building. Since counting systems [vary internationally](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Storey#Consecutive_number_floor_designations), the local system should be used where possible.

terms.label: floorLimit
terms.definition: A floor limit is the amount of money above which credit card transactions must be authorized.

terms.label: floorSize
terms.definition: The size of the accommodation, e.g. in square meter or squarefoot. Typical unit code(s): MTK for square meter, FTK for square foot, or YDK for square yard.

terms.label: followee
terms.definition: A sub property of object. The person or organization being followed.

terms.label: follows
terms.definition: The most generic uni-directional social relation.

terms.label: followup
terms.definition: Typical or recommended followup care after the procedure is performed.

terms.label: foodEstablishment
terms.definition: A sub property of location. The specific food establishment where the action occurred.

terms.label: foodEvent
terms.definition: A sub property of location. The specific food event where the action occurred.

terms.label: foodWarning
terms.definition: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of specific foods while taking this drug.

terms.label: founder
terms.definition: A person or organization who founded this organization.

terms.label: founders
terms.definition: A person who founded this organization.

terms.label: foundingDate
terms.definition: The date that this organization was founded.

terms.label: foundingLocation
terms.definition: The place where the Organization was founded.

terms.label: free
terms.definition: A flag to signal that the item, event, or place is accessible for free.

terms.label: freeShippingThreshold
terms.definition: A monetary value above (or at) which the shipping rate becomes free. Intended to be used via an [[OfferShippingDetails]] with [[shippingSettingsLink]] matching this [[ShippingRateSettings]].

terms.label: frequency
terms.definition: How often the dose is taken, e.g. 'daily'.

terms.label: fromLocation
terms.definition: A sub property of location. The original location of the object or the agent before the action.

terms.label: fuelCapacity
terms.definition: The capacity of the fuel tank or in the case of electric cars, the battery. If there are multiple components for storage, this should indicate the total of all storage of the same type.\n\nTypical unit code(s): LTR for liters, GLL of US gallons, GLI for UK / imperial gallons, AMH for ampere-hours (for electrical vehicles).

terms.label: fuelConsumption
terms.definition:
The amount of fuel consumed for traveling a particular distance or temporal duration with the given vehicle (e.g. liters per 100 km).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for liters per 100 km. Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. L/100 km.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel consumption to another value.

terms.label: fuelEfficiency
terms.definition:
The distance traveled per unit of fuel used; most commonly miles per gallon (mpg) or kilometers per liter (km/L).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for miles per gallon or kilometers per liter. Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. mpg or km/L.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel economy to another value.

terms.label: fuelType
terms.definition: The type of fuel suitable for the engine or engines of the vehicle. If the vehicle has only one engine, this property can be attached directly to the vehicle.

terms.label: fulfillmentType
terms.definition: Type of fulfillment applicable to the [[ShippingService]].

terms.label: functionalClass
terms.definition: The degree of mobility the joint allows.

terms.label: fundedItem
terms.definition: Indicates something directly or indirectly funded or sponsored through a [[Grant]]. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].

terms.label: funder
terms.definition: A person or organization that supports (sponsors) something through some kind of financial contribution.

terms.label: funding
terms.definition: A [[Grant]] that directly or indirectly provide funding or sponsorship for this item. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].

terms.label: game
terms.definition: Video game which is played on this server.

terms.label: gameAvailabilityType
terms.definition: Indicates the availability type of the game content associated with this action, such as whether it is a full version or a demo.

terms.label: gameEdition
terms.definition: The edition of a video game.

terms.label: gameItem
terms.definition: An item is an object within the game world that can be collected by a player or, occasionally, a non-player character.

terms.label: gameLocation
terms.definition: Real or fictional location of the game (or part of game).

terms.label: gamePlatform
terms.definition: The electronic systems used to play video games.

terms.label: gameServer
terms.definition: The server on which it is possible to play the game.

terms.label: gameTip
terms.definition: Links to tips, tactics, etc.

terms.label: gender
terms.definition: Gender of something, typically a [[Person]], but possibly also fictional characters, animals, etc. While https://schema.org/Male and https://schema.org/Female may be used, text strings are also acceptable for people who are not a binary gender. The [[gender]] property can also be used in an extended sense to cover e.g. the gender of sports teams. As with the gender of individuals, we do not try to enumerate all possibilities. A mixed-gender [[SportsTeam]] can be indicated with a text value of "Mixed".

terms.label: genre
terms.definition: Genre of the creative work, broadcast channel or group.

terms.label: geo
terms.definition: The geo coordinates of the place.

terms.label: geoContains
terms.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a containing geometry to a contained geometry. "a contains b iff no points of b lie in the exterior of a, and at least one point of the interior of b lies in the interior of a". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

terms.label: geoCoveredBy
terms.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that covers it. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

terms.label: geoCovers
terms.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a covering geometry to a covered geometry. "Every point of b is a point of (the interior or boundary of) a". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

terms.label: geoCrosses
terms.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that crosses it: "a crosses b: they have some but not all interior points in common, and the dimension of the intersection is less than that of at least one of them". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

terms.label: geoDisjoint
terms.definition: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) are topologically disjoint: "they have no point in common. They form a set of disconnected geometries." (A symmetric relationship, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).)

terms.label: geoEquals
terms.definition: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) are topologically equal, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM). "Two geometries are topologically equal if their interiors intersect and no part of the interior or boundary of one geometry intersects the exterior of the other" (a symmetric relationship).

terms.label: geoIntersects
terms.definition: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) have at least one point in common. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

terms.label: geoMidpoint
terms.definition: Indicates the GeoCoordinates at the centre of a GeoShape, e.g. GeoCircle.

terms.label: geoOverlaps
terms.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that geospatially overlaps it, i.e. they have some but not all points in common. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

terms.label: geoRadius
terms.definition: Indicates the approximate radius of a GeoCircle (metres unless indicated otherwise via Distance notation).

terms.label: geoTouches
terms.definition: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) touch: "they have at least one boundary point in common, but no interior points." (A symmetric relationship, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).)

terms.label: geoWithin
terms.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to one that contains it, i.e. it is inside (i.e. within) its interior. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

terms.label: geographicArea
terms.definition: The geographic area associated with the audience.

terms.label: gettingTestedInfo
terms.definition: Information about getting tested (for a [[MedicalCondition]]), e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

terms.label: givenName
terms.definition: Given name. In the U.S., the first name of a Person.

terms.label: globalLocationNumber
terms.definition: The [Global Location Number](http://www.gs1.org/gln) (GLN, sometimes also referred to as International Location Number or ILN) of the respective organization, person, or place. The GLN is a 13-digit number used to identify parties and physical locations.

terms.label: governmentBenefitsInfo
terms.definition: governmentBenefitsInfo provides information about government benefits associated with a SpecialAnnouncement.

terms.label: gracePeriod
terms.definition: The period of time after any due date that the borrower has to fulfil its obligations before a default (failure to pay) is deemed to have occurred.

terms.label: grantee
terms.definition: The person, organization, contact point, or audience that has been granted this permission.

terms.label: greater
terms.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is greater than the object.

terms.label: greaterOrEqual
terms.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is greater than or equal to the object.

terms.label: gtin
terms.definition: A Global Trade Item Number ([GTIN](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin)). GTINs identify trade items, including products and services, using numeric identification codes. A correct [[gtin]] value should be a valid GTIN, which means that it should be an all-numeric string of either 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, or a "GS1 Digital Link" URL based on such a string. The numeric component should also have a [valid GS1 check digit](https://www.gs1.org/services/check-digit-calculator) and meet the other rules for valid GTINs. See also [GS1's GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) and [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Global_Trade_Item_Number) for more details. Left-padding of the gtin values is not required or encouraged. The [[gtin]] property generalizes the earlier [[gtin8]], [[gtin12]], [[gtin13]], and [[gtin14]] properties. The GS1 [digital link specifications](https://www.gs1.org/standards/Digital-Link/) expresses GTINs as URLs (URIs, IRIs, etc.). Digital Links should be populated into the [[hasGS1DigitalLink]] attribute. Note also that this is a definition for how to include GTINs in Schema.org data, and not a definition of GTINs in general - see the GS1 documentation for authoritative details.

terms.label: gtin12
terms.definition: The GTIN-12 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. The GTIN-12 is the 12-digit GS1 Identification Key composed of a U.P.C. Company Prefix, Item Reference, and Check Digit used to identify trade items. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

terms.label: gtin13
terms.definition: The GTIN-13 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This is equivalent to 13-digit ISBN codes and EAN UCC-13. Former 12-digit UPC codes can be converted into a GTIN-13 code by simply adding a preceding zero. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

terms.label: gtin14
terms.definition: The GTIN-14 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

terms.label: gtin8
terms.definition: The GTIN-8 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This code is also known as EAN/UCC-8 or 8-digit EAN. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

terms.label: guideline
terms.definition: A medical guideline related to this entity.

terms.label: guidelineDate
terms.definition: Date on which this guideline's recommendation was made.

terms.label: guidelineSubject
terms.definition: The medical conditions, treatments, etc. that are the subject of the guideline.

terms.label: handlingTime
terms.definition: The typical delay between the receipt of the order and the goods either leaving the warehouse or being prepared for pickup, in case the delivery method is on site pickup. In the context of [[ShippingDeliveryTime]], Typical properties: minValue, maxValue, unitCode (d for DAY). This is by common convention assumed to mean business days (if a unitCode is used, coded as "d"), i.e. only counting days when the business normally operates. In the context of [[ShippingService]], use the [[ServicePeriod]] format, that contains the same information in a structured form, with cut-off time, business days and duration.

terms.label: hasAdultConsideration
terms.definition: Used to tag an item to be intended or suitable for consumption or use by adults only.

terms.label: hasBioChemEntityPart
terms.definition: Indicates a BioChemEntity that (in some sense) has this BioChemEntity as a part.

terms.label: hasBioPolymerSequence
terms.definition: A symbolic representation of a BioChemEntity. For example, a nucleotide sequence of a Gene or an amino acid sequence of a Protein.

terms.label: hasBroadcastChannel
terms.definition: A broadcast channel of a broadcast service.

terms.label: hasCategoryCode
terms.definition: A Category code contained in this code set.

terms.label: hasCertification
terms.definition: Certification information about a product, organization, service, place, or person.

terms.label: hasCourse
terms.definition: A course or class that is one of the learning opportunities that constitute an educational / occupational program. No information is implied about whether the course is mandatory or optional; no guarantee is implied about whether the course will be available to everyone on the program.

terms.label: hasCourseInstance
terms.definition: An offering of the course at a specific time and place or through specific media or mode of study or to a specific section of students.

terms.label: hasCredential
terms.definition: A credential awarded to the Person or Organization.

terms.label: hasDefinedTerm
terms.definition: A Defined Term contained in this term set.

terms.label: hasDeliveryMethod
terms.definition: Method used for delivery or shipping.

terms.label: hasDigitalDocumentPermission
terms.definition: A permission related to the access to this document (e.g. permission to read or write an electronic document). For a public document, specify a grantee with an Audience with audienceType equal to "public".

terms.label: hasDigitalProductPassport
terms.definition: A link to a Digital Product Passport (DPP) or a digital record detailing the lifecycle, sustainability, and compliance data for this product or offer. This may be a direct URL, a GS1 Digital Link URI, or a nested DigitalProductPassport object. Note: This property is aligned with the IANA 'dpp' link relation and the GS1 Web Vocabulary 'dpp' link type.

terms.label: hasDriveThroughService
terms.definition: Indicates whether some facility (e.g. [[FoodEstablishment]], [[CovidTestingFacility]]) offers a service that can be used by driving through in a car. In the case of [[CovidTestingFacility]] such facilities could potentially help with social distancing from other potentially-infected users.

terms.label: hasEnergyConsumptionDetails
terms.definition: Defines the energy efficiency Category (also known as "class" or "rating") for a product according to an international energy efficiency standard.

terms.label: hasEnergyEfficiencyCategory
terms.definition: Defines the energy efficiency Category (which could be either a rating out of range of values or a yes/no certification) for a product according to an international energy efficiency standard.

terms.label: hasGS1DigitalLink
terms.definition:
The GS1 digital link associated with the object. This URL should conform to the particular requirements of digital links. The link should only contain the Application Identifiers (AIs) that are relevant for the entity being annotated, for instance a [[Product]] or an [[Organization]], and for the correct granularity. In particular, for products:
  • A Digital Link that contains a serial number (AI 21) should only be present on instances of [[IndividualProduct]]
  • A Digital Link that contains a lot number (AI 10) should be annotated as [[SomeProducts]] if only products from that lot are sold, or [[IndividualProduct]] if there is only a specific product.
  • A Digital Link that contains a global model number (AI 8013) should be attached to a [[Product]] or a [[ProductModel]].
Other item types should be adapted similarly.

terms.label: hasHealthAspect
terms.definition: Indicates the aspect or aspects specifically addressed in some [[HealthTopicContent]]. For example, that the content is an overview, or that it talks about treatment, self-care, treatments or their side-effects.

terms.label: hasMap
terms.definition: A URL to a map of the place.

terms.label: hasMeasurement
terms.definition: A measurement of an item, For example, the inseam of pants, the wheel size of a bicycle, the gauge of a screw, or the carbon footprint measured for certification by an authority. Usually an exact measurement, but can also be a range of measurements for adjustable products, for example belts and ski bindings.

terms.label: hasMemberProgram

terms.label: hasMenu

terms.label: hasOfferCatalog

terms.label: hasPart

terms.label: hasParticipationOffer

terms.label: hasProductReturnPolicy

terms.label: hasRepresentation

terms.label: hasShippingService

terms.label: hasSponsorshipOffer

terms.label: hasStore

terms.label: hasTierBenefit

terms.label: hasTierRequirement

If a tier is free to join then this property does not need to be specified.

terms.label: hasTiers

terms.label: hasVariant

The highest price of all offers available.

Usage guidelines:

* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

terms.label: holdingArchive

terms.definition: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.

terms.definition: A physical examination that can identify this sign.

terms.label: identifyingTest
terms.definition: A diagnostic test that can identify this sign.

terms.label: illustrator
terms.definition: The illustrator of the book.

terms.label: image
terms.definition: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

terms.label: imagingTechnique
terms.definition: Imaging technique used.

terms.label: importer
terms.definition: An organization or person who imports the product into a specific market or region.

terms.label: inAlbum
terms.definition: The album to which this recording belongs.

terms.label: inBroadcastLineup
terms.definition: The CableOrSatelliteService offering the channel.

terms.label: inChI
terms.definition: Non-proprietary identifier for molecular entity that can be used in printed and electronic data sources thus enabling easier linking of diverse data compilations.

terms.label: inChIKey
terms.definition: InChIKey is a hashed version of the full InChI (using the SHA-256 algorithm).

terms.label: inCodeSet
terms.definition: A [[CategoryCodeSet]] that contains this category code.

terms.label: inDefinedTermSet
terms.definition: A [[DefinedTermSet]] that contains this term.

terms.label: inLanguage
terms.definition: The language of the content or performance or used in an action. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[availableLanguage]].

terms.label: inPlaylist
terms.definition: The playlist to which this recording belongs.

terms.label: inProductGroupWithID
terms.definition: Indicates the [[productGroupID]] for a [[ProductGroup]] that this product [[isVariantOf]].

terms.label: inStoreReturnsOffered
terms.definition: Are in-store returns offered? (For more advanced return methods use the [[returnMethod]] property.)

terms.label: inSupportOf
terms.definition: Qualification, candidature, degree, application that Thesis supports.

terms.label: incentiveAmount
terms.definition:
Describes the amount that can be redeemed from this incentive.

[[QuantitativeValue]]: Use this for incentives based on price (either raw amount or percentage-based). For a raw amount example, "You can claim $2,500 - $7,500 from the total cost of installation" would be represented as the following:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", “minValue”: 2500, “maxValue”: 7500, "unitCode": "USD" }

[[QuantitativeValue]] can also be used for percentage amounts. In such cases, value is used to represent the incentive’s percentage, while maxValue represents a limit (if one exists) to that incentive. The unitCode should be 'P1' and the unitText should be '%', while valueReference should be used for holding the currency type. For example, "You can claim up to 30% of the total cost of installation, up to a maximum of $7,500" would be:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "value": 30, "unitCode": "P1", "unitText": "%", “maxValue”: 7500, “valueReference”: “USD” }

[[UnitPriceSpecification]]: Use this for incentives that are based on amounts rather than price. For example, a net metering rebate that pays $10/kWh, up to $1,000:

{ "@type": "UnitPriceSpecification", "price": 10, "priceCurrency": "USD", "referenceQuantity": 1, "unitCode": "DO3", "unitText": "kw/h", "maxPrice": 1000, "description": "$10 / kwh up to $1000" }

[[LoanOrCredit]]: Use for incentives that are loan based. For example, a loan of $4,000 - $50,000 with a repayment term of 10 years, interest free would look like:

{ "@type": "LoanOrCredit", "loanTerm": { "@type":"QuantitativeValue", "value":"10", "unitCode": "ANN" }, "amount":[ { "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "Name":"fixed interest rate", "value":"0", }, ], "amount":[ { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "Name":"min loan amount", "value":"4000", "currency":"CAD" }, { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "Name":"max loan amount", "value":"50000", "currency":"CAD" } ], } In summary:
  • Use [[QuantitativeValue]] for absolute/percentage-based incentives applied on the price of a good/service.
  • Use [[UnitPriceSpecification]] for incentives based on a per-unit basis (e.g. net metering).
  • Use [[LoanOrCredit]] for loans/credits.
.

terms.label: incentiveCompensation
terms.definition: Description of bonus and commission compensation aspects of the job.

terms.label: incentiveStatus
terms.definition: The status of the incentive (active, on hold, retired, etc.).

terms.label: incentiveType
terms.definition: The type of incentive offered (tax credit/rebate, tax deduction, tax waiver, subsidies, etc.).

terms.label: incentives
terms.definition: Description of bonus and commission compensation aspects of the job.

terms.label: incentivizedItem
terms.definition:
The type or specific product(s) and/or service(s) being incentivized.

DefinedTermSets are used for product and service categories such as the United Nations Standard Products and Services Code:

{ "@type": "DefinedTerm", "inDefinedTermSet": "https://www.unspsc.org/", "termCode": "261315XX", "name": "Photovoltaic module" }

For a specific product or service, use the Product type:

{ "@type": "Product", "name": "Kenmore White 17" Microwave", } For multiple different incentivized items, use multiple [[DefinedTerm]] or [[Product]].

terms.label: includedComposition
terms.definition: Smaller compositions included in this work (e.g. a movement in a symphony).

terms.label: includedDataCatalog
terms.definition: A data catalog which contains this dataset (this property was previously 'catalog', preferred name is now 'includedInDataCatalog').

terms.label: includedInDataCatalog
terms.definition: A data catalog which contains this dataset.

terms.label: includedInHealthInsurancePlan
terms.definition: The insurance plans that cover this drug.

terms.label: includedRiskFactor
terms.definition: A modifiable or non-modifiable risk factor included in the calculation, e.g. age, coexisting condition.

terms.label: includesAttraction
terms.definition: Attraction located at destination.

terms.label: includesHealthPlanFormulary
terms.definition: Formularies covered by this plan.

terms.label: includesHealthPlanNetwork
terms.definition: Networks covered by this plan.

terms.label: includesObject
terms.definition: This links to a node or nodes indicating the exact quantity of the products included in an [[Offer]] or [[ProductCollection]].

terms.label: incomeLimit
terms.definition:
Optional. Income limit for which the incentive is applicable for.

If MonetaryAmount is specified, this should be based on annualized income (e.g. if an incentive is limited to those making <$114,000 annually):

{ "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "maxValue": 114000, "currency": "USD", } Use Text for incentives that are limited based on other criteria, for example if an incentive is only available to recipients making 120% of the median poverty income in their area.

terms.label: increasesRiskOf
terms.definition: The condition, complication, etc. influenced by this factor.

terms.label: industry
terms.definition: The industry associated with the job position.

terms.label: ineligibleRegion
terms.definition: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is not valid, e.g. a region where the transaction is not allowed.\n\nSee also [[eligibleRegion]].

terms.label: infectiousAgent
terms.definition: The actual infectious agent, such as a specific bacterium.

terms.label: infectiousAgentClass
terms.definition: The class of infectious agent (bacteria, prion, etc.) that causes the disease.

terms.label: ingredients
terms.definition: A single ingredient used in the recipe, e.g. sugar, flour or garlic.

terms.label: inker
terms.definition: The individual who traces over the pencil drawings in ink after pencils are complete.

terms.label: insertion
terms.definition: The place of attachment of a muscle, or what the muscle moves.

terms.label: installUrl
terms.definition: URL at which the app may be installed, if different from the URL of the item.

terms.label: instructor
terms.definition: A person assigned to instruct or provide instructional assistance for the [[CourseInstance]].

terms.label: instrument
terms.definition: The object that helped the agent perform the action. E.g. John wrote a book with *a pen*.

terms.label: intensity
terms.definition: Quantitative measure gauging the degree of force involved in the exercise, for example, heartbeats per minute. May include the velocity of the movement.

terms.label: interactingDrug
terms.definition: Another drug that is known to interact with this drug in a way that impacts the effect of this drug or causes a risk to the patient. Note: disease interactions are typically captured as contraindications.

terms.label: interactionCount
terms.definition: This property is deprecated, alongside the UserInteraction types on which it depended.

terms.label: interactionService
terms.definition: The WebSite or SoftwareApplication where the interactions took place.

terms.label: interactionStatistic
terms.definition: The number of interactions for the CreativeWork using the WebSite or SoftwareApplication. The most specific child type of InteractionCounter should be used.

terms.label: interactionType
terms.definition: The Action representing the type of interaction. For up votes, +1s, etc. use [[LikeAction]]. For down votes use [[DislikeAction]]. Otherwise, use the most specific Action.

terms.label: interactivityType
terms.definition: The predominant mode of learning supported by the learning resource. Acceptable values are 'active', 'expositive', or 'mixed'.

terms.label: interestRate
terms.definition: The interest rate, charged or paid, applicable to the financial product. Note: This is different from the calculated annualPercentageRate.

terms.label: interpretedAsClaim
terms.definition: Used to indicate a specific claim contained, implied, translated or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. The interpreting party can be indicated using [[claimInterpreter]].

terms.label: inventoryLevel
terms.definition: The current approximate inventory level for the item or items.

terms.label: inverseOf
terms.definition: Relates a property to a property that is its inverse. Inverse properties relate the same pairs of items to each other, but in reversed direction. For example, the 'alumni' and 'alumniOf' properties are inverseOf each other. Some properties don't have explicit inverses; in these situations RDFa and JSON-LD syntax for reverse properties can be used.

terms.label: isAcceptingNewPatients
terms.definition: Whether the provider is accepting new patients.

terms.label: isAccessibleForFree
terms.definition: A flag to signal that the item, event, or place is accessible for free.

terms.label: isAccessoryOrSparePartFor
terms.definition: A pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is an accessory or spare part.

terms.label: isAvailableGenerically
terms.definition: True if the drug is available in a generic form (regardless of name).

terms.label: isBasedOn
terms.definition: A resource from which this work is derived or from which it is a modification or adaptation.

terms.label: isBasedOnUrl
terms.definition: A resource that was used in the creation of this resource. This term can be repeated for multiple sources. For example, http://example.com/great-multiplication-intro.html.

terms.label: isConsumableFor
terms.definition: A pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is a consumable.

terms.label: isEncodedByBioChemEntity
terms.definition: Another BioChemEntity encoding by this one.

terms.label: isFamilyFriendly
terms.definition: Indicates whether this content is family friendly.

terms.label: isGift
terms.definition: Indicates whether the offer was accepted as a gift for someone other than the buyer.

terms.label: isInvolvedInBiologicalProcess
terms.definition: Biological process this BioChemEntity is involved in; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

terms.label: isLiveBroadcast
terms.definition: True if the broadcast is of a live event.

terms.label: isLocatedInSubcellularLocation
terms.definition: Subcellular location where this BioChemEntity is located; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

terms.label: isOftenBoughtWith
terms.definition: Indicates a product that is often bought with the described product.

terms.label: isPartOf
terms.definition: Indicates an item or CreativeWork that this item, or CreativeWork (in some sense), is part of.

terms.label: isPartOfBioChemEntity
terms.definition: Indicates a BioChemEntity that is (in some sense) a part of this BioChemEntity.

terms.label: isPlanForApartment
terms.definition: Indicates some accommodation that this floor plan describes.

terms.label: isProprietary
terms.definition: True if this item's name is a proprietary/brand name (vs. generic name).

terms.label: isRelatedTo
terms.definition: A pointer to another, somehow related product (or multiple products).

terms.label: isResizable
terms.definition: Whether the 3DModel allows resizing. For example, room layout applications often do not allow 3DModel elements to be resized to reflect reality.

terms.label: isSimilarTo
terms.definition: A pointer to another, functionally similar product (or multiple products).

terms.label: isStoreOn
terms.definition: The eCommerce marketplace this online store is on.

terms.label: isTierOf
terms.definition: The member program this tier is a part of.

terms.label: isUnlabelledFallback
terms.definition: This can be marked 'true' to indicate that some published [[DeliveryTimeSettings]] or [[ShippingRateSettings]] are intended to apply to all [[OfferShippingDetails]] published by the same merchant, when referenced by a [[shippingSettingsLink]] in those settings. It is not meaningful to use a 'true' value for this property alongside a transitTimeLabel (for [[DeliveryTimeSettings]]) or shippingLabel (for [[ShippingRateSettings]]), since this property is for use with unlabelled settings.

terms.label: isVariantOf
terms.definition: Indicates the kind of product that this is a variant of. In the case of [[ProductModel]], this is a pointer (from a ProductModel) to a base product from which this product is a variant. It is safe to infer that the variant inherits all product features from the base model, unless defined locally. This is not transitive. In the case of a [[ProductGroup]], the group description also serves as a template, representing a set of Products that vary on explicitly defined, specific dimensions only (so it defines both a set of variants, as well as which values distinguish amongst those variants). When used with [[ProductGroup]], this property can apply to any [[Product]] included in the group.

terms.label: isbn
terms.definition: The ISBN of the book.

terms.label: isicV4
terms.definition: The International Standard of Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities (ISIC), Revision 4 code for a particular organization, business person, or place.

terms.label: iso6523Code
terms.definition: An organization identifier as defined in [ISO 6523(-1)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO/IEC_6523). The identifier should be in the `XXXX:YYYYYY:ZZZ` or `XXXX:YYYYYY`format. Where `XXXX` is a 4 digit _ICD_ (International Code Designator), `YYYYYY` is an _OID_ (Organization Identifier) with all formatting characters (dots, dashes, spaces) removed with a maximal length of 35 characters, and `ZZZ` is an optional OPI (Organization Part Identifier) with a maximum length of 35 characters. The various components (ICD, OID, OPI) are joined with a colon character (ASCII `0x3a`). Note that many existing organization identifiers defined as attributes like [leiCode](https://schema.org/leiCode) (`0199`), [duns](https://schema.org/duns) (`0060`) or [GLN](https://schema.org/globalLocationNumber) (`0088`) can be expressed using ISO-6523. If possible, ISO-6523 codes should be preferred to populating [vatID](https://schema.org/vatID) or [taxID](https://schema.org/taxID), as ISO identifiers are less ambiguous.

terms.label: isrcCode
terms.definition: The International Standard Recording Code for the recording.

terms.label: issn
terms.definition: The International Standard Serial Number (ISSN) that identifies this serial publication. You can repeat this property to identify different formats of, or the linking ISSN (ISSN-L) for, this serial publication.

terms.label: issueNumber
terms.definition: Identifies the issue of publication; for example, "iii" or "2".

terms.label: issuedBy
terms.definition: The organization issuing the item, for example a [[Permit]], [[Ticket]], or [[Certification]].

terms.label: issuedThrough
terms.definition: The service through which the permit was granted.

terms.label: iswcCode
terms.definition: The International Standard Musical Work Code for the composition.

terms.label: item
terms.definition: An entity represented by an entry in a list or data feed (e.g. an 'artist' in a list of 'artists').

terms.label: itemCondition
terms.definition: A predefined value from OfferItemCondition specifying the condition of the product or service, or the products or services included in the offer. Also used for product return policies to specify the condition of products accepted for returns.

terms.label: itemDefectReturnFees
terms.definition: The type of return fees for returns of defect products.

terms.label: itemDefectReturnLabelSource
terms.definition: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a defect product.

terms.label: itemDefectReturnShippingFeesAmount
terms.definition: Amount of shipping costs for defect product returns. Applicable when property [[itemDefectReturnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

terms.label: itemListElement
terms.definition:
For itemListElement values, you can use simple strings (e.g. "Peter", "Paul", "Mary"), existing entities, or use ListItem.

Text values are best if the elements in the list are plain strings. Existing entities are best for a simple, unordered list of existing things in your data. ListItem is used with ordered lists when you want to provide additional context about the element in that list or when the same item might be in different places in different lists.

Note: The order of elements in your mark-up is not sufficient for indicating the order or elements. Use ListItem with a 'position' property in such cases.

terms.label: itemListOrder
terms.definition: Type of ordering (e.g. Ascending, Descending, Unordered).

terms.label: itemLocation
terms.definition: Current location of the item.

terms.label: itemOffered
terms.definition: An item being offered (or demanded). The transactional nature of the offer or demand is documented using [[businessFunction]], e.g. sell, lease etc. While several common expected types are listed explicitly in this definition, others can be used. Using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

terms.label: itemPopularity
terms.definition: A measure of the relative popularity or sales rank of the offer within a marketplace, catalog, or platform (e.g. a platform-specific bestseller ranking or sales rank). This property is intended for platform-level or catalog-wide comparative rankings rather than self-asserted promotional claims.

terms.label: itemReviewed
terms.definition: The item that is being reviewed/rated.

terms.label: itemShipped
terms.definition: Item(s) being shipped.

terms.label: itinerary
terms.definition: Destination(s) ( [[Place]] ) that make up a trip. For a trip where destination order is important use [[ItemList]] to specify that order (see examples).

terms.label: iupacName
terms.definition: Systematic method of naming chemical compounds as recommended by the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC).

terms.label: jobBenefits
terms.definition: Description of benefits associated with the job.

terms.label: jobDuration
terms.definition: The expected duration of an employment offer as advertised by the employer. Relevant for job postings that have a clearly defined period in mind such as seasonal work, substitutes for maternal leave or any other temporary employment.

terms.label: jobImmediateStart
terms.definition: An indicator as to whether a position is available for an immediate start.

terms.label: jobLocation
terms.definition: A (typically single) geographic location associated with the job position.

terms.label: jobLocationType
terms.definition: A description of the job location (e.g. TELECOMMUTE for telecommute jobs).

terms.label: jobStartDate
terms.definition: The date on which a successful applicant for this job would be expected to start work. Choose a specific date in the future or use the jobImmediateStart property to indicate the position is to be filled as soon as possible.

terms.label: jobTitle
terms.definition: The job title of the person (for example, Financial Manager).

terms.label: jurisdiction
terms.definition: Indicates a legal jurisdiction, e.g. of some legislation, or where some government service is based.

terms.label: keywords
terms.definition: Keywords or tags used to describe some item. Multiple textual entries in a keywords list are typically delimited by commas, or by repeating the property.

terms.label: knownVehicleDamages
terms.definition: A textual description of known damages, both repaired and unrepaired.

terms.label: knows
terms.definition: The most generic bi-directional social/work relation.

terms.label: knowsAbout
terms.definition: Of a [[Person]], and less typically of an [[Organization]], to indicate a topic that is known about - suggesting possible expertise but not implying it. We do not distinguish skill levels here, or relate this to educational content, events, objectives or [[JobPosting]] descriptions.

terms.label: knowsLanguage
terms.definition: Of a [[Person]], and less typically of an [[Organization]], to indicate a known language. We do not distinguish skill levels or reading/writing/speaking/signing here. Use language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47).

terms.label: labelDetails
terms.definition: Link to the drug's label details.

terms.label: landlord
terms.definition: A sub property of participant. The owner of the real estate property.

terms.label: language
terms.definition: A sub property of instrument. The language used on this action.

terms.label: lastReviewed
terms.definition: Date on which the content on this web page was last reviewed for accuracy and/or completeness.

terms.label: latitude
terms.definition: The latitude of a location. For example ```37.42242``` ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)).

terms.label: layoutImage
terms.definition: A schematic image showing the floorplan layout.

terms.label: learningResourceType
terms.definition: The predominant type or kind characterizing the learning resource. For example, 'presentation', 'handout'.

terms.label: leaseLength
terms.definition: Length of the lease for some [[Accommodation]], either particular to some [[Offer]] or in some cases intrinsic to the property.

terms.label: legalAddress
terms.definition: The legal address of an organization which acts as the officially registered address used for legal and tax purposes. The legal address can be different from the place of operations of a business and other addresses can be part of an organization.

terms.label: legalName
terms.definition: The official name of the organization, e.g. the registered company name.

terms.label: legalRepresentative
terms.definition: One or multiple persons who represent this organization legally such as CEO or sole administrator.

terms.label: legalStatus
terms.definition: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.

terms.label: legislationAmends
terms.definition: Another legislation that this legislation amends, introducing legal changes.

terms.label: legislationApplies
terms.definition: Indicates that this legislation (or part of a legislation) somehow transfers another legislation in a different legislative context. This is an informative link, and it has no legal value. For legally-binding links of transposition, use the legislationTransposes property. For example an informative consolidated law of a European Union's member state "applies" the consolidated version of the European Directive implemented in it.

terms.label: legislationChanges
terms.definition: Another legislation that this legislation changes. This encompasses the notions of amendment, replacement, correction, repeal, or other types of change. This may be a direct change (textual or non-textual amendment) or a consequential or indirect change. The property is to be used to express the existence of a change relationship between two acts rather than the existence of a consolidated version of the text that shows the result of the change. For consolidation relationships, use the legislationConsolidates property.

terms.label: legislationCommences
terms.definition: Another legislation that this one sets into force.

terms.label: legislationConsolidates
terms.definition: Indicates another legislation taken into account in this consolidated legislation (which is usually the product of an editorial process that revises the legislation). This property should be used multiple times to refer to both the original version or the previous consolidated version, and to the legislations making the change.

terms.label: legislationCorrects
terms.definition: Another legislation in which this one introduces textual changes, like correction of spelling mistakes, with no legal impact (for modifications that have legal impact, use legislationAmends).

terms.label: legislationCountersignedBy
terms.definition: The person or organization that countersigned the legislation. Depending on the legal context, a countersignature can indicate that the signed authority undertakes to assume responsibility for texts emanating from a person who is inviolable and irresponsible, (for example a King, Grand Duc or President), or that the authority is in charge of the implementation of the text.

terms.label: legislationDate
terms.definition: The date of adoption or signature of the legislation. This is the date at which the text is officially aknowledged to be a legislation, even though it might not even be published or in force.

terms.label: legislationDateOfApplicability
terms.definition: The date at which the Legislation becomes applicable. This can sometimes be distinct from the date of entry into force : a text may come in force today, and state it will become applicable in 3 months.

terms.label: legislationDateVersion
terms.definition: The point-in-time at which the provided description of the legislation is valid (e.g.: when looking at the law on the 2016-04-07 (= dateVersion), I get the consolidation of 2015-04-12 of the "National Insurance Contributions Act 2015")

terms.label: legislationEnsuresImplementationOf
terms.definition: Indicates that this Legislation ensures the implementation of another Legislation, for example by modifying national legislations so that they do not contradict to an EU regulation or decision. This implies a legal meaning. Transpositions of EU Directive should be captured with legislationTransposes.

terms.label: legislationIdentifier
terms.definition: An identifier for the legislation. This can be either a string-based identifier, like the CELEX at EU level or the NOR in France, or a web-based, URL/URI identifier, like an ELI (European Legislation Identifier) or an URN-Lex.

terms.label: legislationJurisdiction
terms.definition: The jurisdiction from which the legislation originates.

terms.label: legislationLegalForce
terms.definition: Whether the legislation is currently in force, not in force, or partially in force.

terms.label: legislationLegalValue
terms.definition: The legal value of this legislation file. The same legislation can be written in multiple files with different legal values. Typically a digitally signed PDF have a "stronger" legal value than the HTML file of the same act.

terms.label: legislationPassedBy
terms.definition: The person or organization that originally passed or made the law: typically parliament (for primary legislation) or government (for secondary legislation). This indicates the "legal author" of the law, as opposed to its physical author.

terms.label: legislationRepeals
terms.definition: Another legislation that this legislation repeals (cancels, abrogates).

terms.label: legislationResponsible
terms.definition: An individual or organization that has some kind of responsibility for the legislation. Typically the ministry who is/was in charge of elaborating the legislation, or the adressee for potential questions about the legislation once it is published.

terms.label: legislationTransposes
terms.definition: Indicates that this legislation (or part of legislation) fulfills the objectives set by another legislation, by passing appropriate implementation measures. Typically, some legislations of European Union's member states or regions transpose European Directives. This indicates a legally binding link between the 2 legislations.

terms.label: legislationType
terms.definition: The type of the legislation. Examples of values are "law", "act", "directive", "decree", "regulation", "statutory instrument", "loi organique", "règlement grand-ducal", etc., depending on the country.

terms.label: leiCode
terms.definition: An organization identifier that uniquely identifies a legal entity as defined in ISO 17442.

terms.label: lender
terms.definition: A sub property of participant. The person that lends the object being borrowed.

terms.label: lesser
terms.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is lesser than the object.

terms.label: lesserOrEqual
terms.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is lesser than or equal to the object.

terms.label: letterer
terms.definition: The individual who adds lettering, including speech balloons and sound effects, to artwork.

terms.label: license
terms.definition: A license document that applies to this content, typically indicated by URL.

terms.label: lifeEvent
terms.definition: A life event like baptism, communions, Bar Mitzvahs, Aqiqah, Namakarana, Miyamairi, burial, ....

terms.label: line
terms.definition: A line is a point-to-point path consisting of two or more points. A line is expressed as a series of two or more point objects separated by space.

terms.label: linkRelationship
terms.definition: Indicates the relationship type of a Web link.

terms.label: liveBlogUpdate
terms.definition: An update to the LiveBlog.

terms.label: loanMortgageMandateAmount
terms.definition: Amount of mortgage mandate that can be converted into a proper mortgage at a later stage.

terms.label: loanPaymentAmount
terms.definition: The amount of money to pay in a single payment.

terms.label: loanPaymentFrequency
terms.definition: Frequency of payments due, i.e. number of months between payments. This is defined as a frequency, i.e. the reciprocal of a period of time.

terms.label: loanRepaymentForm
terms.definition: A form of paying back money previously borrowed from a lender. Repayment usually takes the form of periodic payments that normally include part principal plus interest in each payment.

terms.label: loanTerm
terms.definition: The duration of the loan or credit agreement.

terms.label: loanType
terms.definition: The type of a loan or credit.

terms.label: location
terms.definition: The location of, for example, where an event is happening, where an organization is located, or where an action takes place.

terms.label: locationCreated
terms.definition: The location where the CreativeWork was created, which may not be the same as the location depicted in the CreativeWork.

terms.label: lodgingUnitDescription
terms.definition: A full description of the lodging unit.

terms.label: lodgingUnitType
terms.definition: Textual description of the unit type (including suite vs. room, size of bed, etc.).

terms.label: logo
terms.definition: An associated logo.

terms.label: longitude
terms.definition: The longitude of a location. For example ```-122.08585``` ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)).

terms.label: loser
terms.definition: A sub property of participant. The loser of the action.

terms.label: lowPrice
terms.definition:
The lowest price of all offers available.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

terms.label: lyricist
terms.definition: The person who wrote the words.

terms.label: lyrics
terms.definition: The words in the song.

terms.label: mainContentOfPage
terms.definition: Indicates if this web page element is the main subject of the page.

terms.label: mainEntity
terms.definition: Indicates the primary entity described in some page or other CreativeWork.

terms.label: mainEntityOfPage
terms.definition: Indicates a page (or other CreativeWork) for which this thing is the main entity being described. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#mainEntityBackground) for details.

terms.label: maintainer
terms.definition: A maintainer of a [[Dataset]], software package ([[SoftwareApplication]]), or other [[Project]]. A maintainer is a [[Person]] or [[Organization]] that manages contributions to, and/or publication of, some (typically complex) artifact. It is common for distributions of software and data to be based on "upstream" sources. When [[maintainer]] is applied to a specific version of something e.g. a particular version or packaging of a [[Dataset]], it is always possible that the upstream source has a different maintainer. The [[isBasedOn]] property can be used to indicate such relationships between datasets to make the different maintenance roles clear. Similarly in the case of software, a package may have dedicated maintainers working on integration into software distributions such as Ubuntu, as well as upstream maintainers of the underlying work.

terms.label: makesOffer
terms.definition: A pointer to products or services offered by the organization or person.

terms.label: manufacturer
terms.definition: The manufacturer of the product.

terms.label: map
terms.definition: A URL to a map of the place.

terms.label: mapType
terms.definition: Indicates the kind of Map, from the MapCategoryType Enumeration.

terms.label: maps
terms.definition: A URL to a map of the place.

terms.label: marginOfError
terms.definition: A [[marginOfError]] for an [[Observation]].

terms.label: masthead
terms.definition: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a link to the masthead page or a page listing top editorial management.

terms.label: material
terms.definition: A material that something is made from, e.g. leather, wool, cotton, paper.

terms.label: materialExtent
terms.definition: The quantity of the materials being described or an expression of the physical space they occupy.

terms.label: mathExpression
terms.definition: A mathematical expression (e.g. 'x^2-3x=0') that may be solved for a specific variable, simplified, or transformed. This can take many formats, e.g. LaTeX, Ascii-Math, or math as you would write with a keyboard.

terms.label: maxPrice
terms.definition: The highest price if the price is a range.

terms.label: maxValue
terms.definition: The upper value of some characteristic or property.

terms.label: maximumAttendeeCapacity
terms.definition: The total number of individuals that may attend an event or venue.

terms.label: maximumEnrollment
terms.definition: The maximum number of students who may be enrolled in the program.

terms.label: maximumIntake
terms.definition: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.

terms.label: maximumPhysicalAttendeeCapacity
terms.definition: The maximum physical attendee capacity of an [[Event]] whose [[eventAttendanceMode]] is [[OfflineEventAttendanceMode]] (or the offline aspects, in the case of a [[MixedEventAttendanceMode]]).

terms.label: maximumVirtualAttendeeCapacity
terms.definition: The maximum virtual attendee capacity of an [[Event]] whose [[eventAttendanceMode]] is [[OnlineEventAttendanceMode]] (or the online aspects, in the case of a [[MixedEventAttendanceMode]]).

terms.label: mealService
terms.definition: Description of the meals that will be provided or available for purchase.

terms.label: measuredProperty
terms.definition: The measuredProperty of an [[Observation]], typically via its [[StatisticalVariable]]. There are various kinds of applicable [[Property]]: a schema.org property, a property from other RDF-compatible systems, e.g. W3C RDF Data Cube, Data Commons, Wikidata, or schema.org extensions such as [GS1's](https://www.gs1.org/voc/?show=properties).

terms.label: measurementDenominator
terms.definition: Identifies the denominator variable when an observation represents a ratio or percentage.

terms.label: measurementMethod
terms.definition: A subproperty of [[measurementTechnique]] that can be used for specifying specific methods, in particular via [[MeasurementMethodEnum]].

terms.label: measurementQualifier
terms.definition: Provides additional qualification to an observation. For example, a GDP observation measures the Nominal value.

terms.label: measurementTechnique
terms.definition: A technique, method or technology used in an [[Observation]], [[StatisticalVariable]] or [[Dataset]] (or [[DataDownload]], [[DataCatalog]]), corresponding to the method used for measuring the corresponding variable(s) (for datasets, described using [[variableMeasured]]; for [[Observation]], a [[StatisticalVariable]]). Often but not necessarily each [[variableMeasured]] will have an explicit representation as (or mapping to) an property such as those defined in Schema.org, or other RDF vocabularies and "knowledge graphs". In that case the subproperty of [[variableMeasured]] called [[measuredProperty]] is applicable. The [[measurementTechnique]] property helps when extra clarification is needed about how a [[measuredProperty]] was measured. This is oriented towards scientific and scholarly dataset publication but may have broader applicability; it is not intended as a full representation of measurement, but can often serve as a high level summary for dataset discovery. For example, if [[variableMeasured]] is: molecule concentration, [[measurementTechnique]] could be: "mass spectrometry" or "nmr spectroscopy" or "colorimetry" or "immunofluorescence". If the [[variableMeasured]] is "depression rating", the [[measurementTechnique]] could be "Zung Scale" or "HAM-D" or "Beck Depression Inventory". If there are several [[variableMeasured]] properties recorded for some given data object, use a [[PropertyValue]] for each [[variableMeasured]] and attach the corresponding [[measurementTechnique]]. The value can also be from an enumeration, organized as a [[MeasurementMethodEnum]].

terms.label: mechanismOfAction
terms.definition: The specific biochemical interaction through which this drug or supplement produces its pharmacological effect.

terms.label: mediaAuthenticityCategory
terms.definition: Indicates a MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration classification of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared).

terms.label: mediaItemAppearance
terms.definition: In the context of a [[MediaReview]], indicates specific media item(s) that are grouped using a [[MediaReviewItem]].

terms.label: median
terms.definition: The median value.

terms.label: medicalAudience
terms.definition: Medical audience for page.

terms.label: medicalSpecialty
terms.definition: A medical specialty of the provider.

terms.label: medicineSystem
terms.definition: The system of medicine that includes this MedicalEntity, for example 'evidence-based', 'homeopathic', 'chiropractic', etc.

terms.label: meetsEmissionStandard
terms.definition: Indicates that the vehicle meets the respective emission standard.

terms.label: member
terms.definition: A member of an Organization or a ProgramMembership. Organizations can be members of organizations; ProgramMembership is typically for individuals.

terms.label: memberOf
terms.definition: An Organization (or ProgramMembership) to which this Person or Organization belongs.

terms.label: members
terms.definition: A member of this organization.

terms.label: membershipNumber
terms.definition: A unique identifier for the membership.

terms.label: membershipPointsEarned
terms.definition: The number of membership points earned by the member. If necessary, the unitText can be used to express the units the points are issued in. (E.g. stars, miles, etc.)

terms.label: memoryRequirements
terms.definition: Minimum memory requirements.

terms.label: mentions
terms.definition: Indicates that the CreativeWork contains a reference to, but is not necessarily about a concept.

terms.label: menu
terms.definition: Either the actual menu as a structured representation, as text, or a URL of the menu.

terms.label: menuAddOn
terms.definition: Additional menu item(s) such as a side dish of salad or side order of fries that can be added to this menu item. Additionally it can be a menu section containing allowed add-on menu items for this menu item.

terms.label: merchant
terms.definition: 'merchant' is an out-dated term for 'seller'.

terms.label: merchantReturnDays
terms.definition: Specifies either a fixed return date or the number of days (from the delivery date) that a product can be returned. Used when the [[returnPolicyCategory]] property is specified as [[MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow]].

terms.label: merchantReturnLink
terms.definition: Specifies a Web page or service by URL, for product returns.

terms.label: messageAttachment
terms.definition: A CreativeWork attached to the message.

terms.label: mileageFromOdometer
terms.definition: The total distance travelled by the particular vehicle since its initial production, as read from its odometer.\n\nTypical unit code(s): KMT for kilometers, SMI for statute miles.

terms.label: minPrice
terms.definition: The lowest price if the price is a range.

terms.label: minValue
terms.definition: The lower value of some characteristic or property.

terms.label: minimumOrderValue
terms.definition: The minimum order value required for this shipping rate to apply.

terms.label: minimumPaymentDue
terms.definition: The minimum payment required at this time.

terms.label: missionCoveragePrioritiesPolicy
terms.definition: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a statement on coverage priorities, including any public agenda or stance on issues.

terms.label: mobileUrl
terms.definition: The [[mobileUrl]] property is provided for specific situations in which data consumers need to determine whether one of several provided URLs is a dedicated 'mobile site'. To discourage over-use, and reflecting intial usecases, the property is expected only on [[Product]] and [[Offer]], rather than [[Thing]]. The general trend in web technology is towards [responsive design](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Responsive_web_design) in which content can be flexibly adapted to a wide range of browsing environments. Pages and sites referenced with the long-established [[url]] property should ideally also be usable on a wide variety of devices, including mobile phones. In most cases, it would be pointless and counter productive to attempt to update all [[url]] markup to use [[mobileUrl]] for more mobile-oriented pages. The property is intended for the case when items (primarily [[Product]] and [[Offer]]) have extra URLs hosted on an additional "mobile site" alongside the main one. It should not be taken as an endorsement of this publication style.

terms.label: model
terms.definition: The model of the product. Use with the URL of a ProductModel or a textual representation of the model identifier. The URL of the ProductModel can be from an external source. It is recommended to additionally provide strong product identifiers via the gtin8/gtin13/gtin14 and mpn properties.

terms.label: modelDate
terms.definition: The release date of a vehicle model (often used to differentiate versions of the same make and model).

terms.label: modifiedTime
terms.definition: The date and time the reservation was modified.

terms.label: molecularFormula
terms.definition: The empirical formula is the simplest whole number ratio of all the atoms in a molecule.

terms.label: molecularWeight
terms.definition: This is the molecular weight of the entity being described, not of the parent. Units should be included in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '12 amu' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.

terms.label: monoisotopicMolecularWeight
terms.definition: The monoisotopic mass is the sum of the masses of the atoms in a molecule using the unbound, ground-state, rest mass of the principal (most abundant) isotope for each element instead of the isotopic average mass. Please include the units in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '770.230488 g/mol' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.

terms.label: monthlyMinimumRepaymentAmount
terms.definition: The minimum payment is the lowest amount of money that one is required to pay on a credit card statement each month.

terms.label: monthsOfExperience
terms.definition: Indicates the minimal number of months of experience required for a position.

terms.label: mpn
terms.definition: The Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the product, or the product to which the offer refers.

terms.label: multipleValues
terms.definition: Whether multiple values are allowed for the property. Default is false.

terms.label: muscleAction
terms.definition: The movement the muscle generates.

terms.label: musicArrangement
terms.definition: An arrangement derived from the composition.

terms.label: musicBy
terms.definition: The composer of the soundtrack.

terms.label: musicCompositionForm
terms.definition: The type of composition (e.g. overture, sonata, symphony, etc.).

terms.label: musicGroupMember
terms.definition: A member of a music group—for example, John, Paul, George, or Ringo.

terms.label: musicReleaseFormat
terms.definition: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

terms.label: musicalKey
terms.definition: The key, mode, or scale this composition uses.

terms.label: naics
terms.definition: The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for a particular organization or business person.

terms.label: name
terms.definition: The name of the item.

terms.label: namedPosition
terms.definition: A position played, performed or filled by a person or organization, as part of an organization. For example, an athlete in a SportsTeam might play in the position named 'Quarterback'.

terms.label: nationality
terms.definition: Nationality of the person.

terms.label: naturalProgression
terms.definition: The expected progression of the condition if it is not treated and allowed to progress naturally.

terms.label: negativeNotes
terms.definition: Provides negative considerations regarding something, most typically in pro/con lists for reviews (alongside [[positiveNotes]]). For symmetry In the case of a [[Review]], the property describes the [[itemReviewed]] from the perspective of the review; in the case of a [[Product]], the product itself is being described. Since product descriptions tend to emphasise positive claims, it may be relatively unusual to find [[negativeNotes]] used in this way. Nevertheless for the sake of symmetry, [[negativeNotes]] can be used on [[Product]]. The property values can be expressed either as unstructured text (repeated as necessary), or if ordered, as a list (in which case the most negative is at the beginning of the list).

terms.label: nerve
terms.definition: The underlying innervation associated with the muscle.

terms.label: nerveMotor
terms.definition: The neurological pathway extension that involves muscle control.

terms.label: netWorth
terms.definition: The total financial value of the person as calculated by subtracting the total value of liabilities from the total value of assets.

terms.label: newsUpdatesAndGuidelines
