terms.definition: Indicates a page with news updates and guidelines. This could often be (but is not required to be) the main page containing [[SpecialAnnouncement]] markup on a site.

terms.label: nextItem
terms.definition: A link to the ListItem that follows the current one.

terms.label: noBylinesPolicy
terms.definition: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other news-related [[Organization]], a statement explaining when authors of articles are not named in bylines.

terms.label: nonEqual
terms.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is not equal to the object.

terms.label: nonProprietaryName
terms.definition: The generic name of this drug or supplement.

terms.label: nonprofitStatus
terms.definition: nonprofitStatus indicates the legal status of a non-profit organization in its primary place of business.

terms.label: normalRange
terms.definition: Range of acceptable values for a typical patient, when applicable.

terms.label: nsn
terms.definition: Indicates the [NATO stock number](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NATO_Stock_Number) (nsn) of a [[Product]].

terms.label: numAdults
terms.definition: The number of adults staying in the unit.

terms.label: numChildren
terms.definition: The number of children staying in the unit.

terms.label: numConstraints
terms.definition: Indicates the number of constraints property values defined for a particular [[ConstraintNode]] such as [[StatisticalVariable]]. This helps applications understand if they have access to a sufficiently complete description of a [[StatisticalVariable]] or other construct that is defined using properties on template-style nodes.

terms.label: numItems
terms.definition: Limits the number of items being shipped for which these conditions apply.

terms.label: numTracks
terms.definition: The number of tracks in this album or playlist.

terms.label: numberOfAccommodationUnits
terms.definition: Indicates the total (available plus unavailable) number of accommodation units in an [[ApartmentComplex]], or the number of accommodation units for a specific [[FloorPlan]] (within its specific [[ApartmentComplex]]). See also [[numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits]].

terms.label: numberOfAirbags
terms.definition: The number or type of airbags in the vehicle.

terms.label: numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits
terms.definition: Indicates the number of available accommodation units in an [[ApartmentComplex]], or the number of accommodation units for a specific [[FloorPlan]] (within its specific [[ApartmentComplex]]). See also [[numberOfAccommodationUnits]].

terms.label: numberOfAxles
terms.definition: The number of axles.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

terms.label: numberOfBathroomsTotal
terms.definition: The total integer number of bathrooms in some [[Accommodation]], following real estate conventions as [documented in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsTotalInteger+Field): "The simple sum of the number of bathrooms. For example for a property with two Full Bathrooms and one Half Bathroom, the Bathrooms Total Integer will be 3.". See also [[numberOfRooms]].

terms.label: numberOfBedrooms
terms.definition: The total integer number of bedrooms in a some [[Accommodation]], [[ApartmentComplex]] or [[FloorPlan]].

terms.label: numberOfBeds
terms.definition: The quantity of the given bed type available in the HotelRoom, Suite, House, or Apartment.

terms.label: numberOfCredits
terms.definition: The number of credits or units awarded by a Course or required to complete an EducationalOccupationalProgram.

terms.label: numberOfDoors
terms.definition: The number of doors.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

terms.label: numberOfEmployees
terms.definition: The number of employees in an organization, e.g. business.

terms.label: numberOfEpisodes
terms.definition: The number of episodes in this season or series.

terms.label: numberOfForwardGears
terms.definition: The total number of forward gears available for the transmission system of the vehicle.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

terms.label: numberOfFullBathrooms
terms.definition: Number of full bathrooms - The total number of full and ¾ bathrooms in an [[Accommodation]]. This corresponds to the [BathroomsFull field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsFull+Field).

terms.label: numberOfItems
terms.definition: The number of items in an ItemList. Note that some descriptions might not fully describe all items in a list (e.g., multi-page pagination); in such cases, the numberOfItems would be for the entire list.

terms.label: numberOfLoanPayments
terms.definition: The number of payments contractually required at origination to repay the loan. For monthly paying loans this is the number of months from the contractual first payment date to the maturity date.

terms.label: numberOfPages
terms.definition: The number of pages in the book.

terms.label: numberOfPartialBathrooms
terms.definition: Number of partial bathrooms - The total number of half and ¼ bathrooms in an [[Accommodation]]. This corresponds to the [BathroomsPartial field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/BathroomsPartial+Field).

terms.label: numberOfPlayers
terms.definition: Indicate how many people can play this game (minimum, maximum, or range).

terms.label: numberOfPreviousOwners
terms.definition: The number of owners of the vehicle, including the current one.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

terms.label: numberOfRooms
terms.definition: The number of rooms (excluding bathrooms and closets) of the accommodation or lodging business. Typical unit code(s): ROM for room or C62 for no unit. The type of room can be put in the unitText property of the QuantitativeValue.

terms.label: numberOfSeasons
terms.definition: The number of seasons in this series.

terms.label: numberedPosition
terms.definition: A number associated with a role in an organization, for example, the number on an athlete's jersey.

terms.label: nutrition
terms.definition: Nutrition information about the recipe or menu item.

terms.label: object
terms.definition: The object upon which the action is carried out, whose state is kept intact or changed. Also known as the semantic roles patient, affected or undergoer (which change their state) or theme (which doesn't). E.g. John read *a book*.

terms.label: observationAbout
terms.definition: The [[observationAbout]] property identifies an entity, often a [[Place]], associated with an [[Observation]].

terms.label: observationDate
terms.definition: The observationDate of an [[Observation]].

terms.label: observationPeriod
terms.definition: The length of time an Observation took place over. The format follows `P[0-9]*[Y|M|D|h|m|s]`. For example, P1Y is Period 1 Year, P3M is Period 3 Months, P3h is Period 3 hours.

terms.label: occupancy
terms.definition: The allowed total occupancy for the accommodation in persons (including infants etc). For individual accommodations, this is not necessarily the legal maximum but defines the permitted usage as per the contractual agreement (e.g. a double room used by a single person). Typical unit code(s): C62 for person.

terms.label: occupationLocation
terms.definition: The region/country for which this occupational description is appropriate. Note that educational requirements and qualifications can vary between jurisdictions.

terms.label: occupationalCategory
terms.definition: A category describing the job, preferably using a term from a taxonomy such as [BLS O*NET-SOC](http://www.onetcenter.org/taxonomy.html), [ISCO-08](https://www.ilo.org/public/english/bureau/stat/isco/isco08/) or similar, with the property repeated for each applicable value. Ideally the taxonomy should be identified, and both the textual label and formal code for the category should be provided.\n Note: for historical reasons, any textual label and formal code provided as a literal may be assumed to be from O*NET-SOC.

terms.label: occupationalCredentialAwarded
terms.definition: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other occupational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

terms.label: offerCount
terms.definition: The number of offers for the product.

terms.label: offeredBy
terms.definition: A pointer to the organization or person making the offer.

terms.label: offers
terms.definition: An offer to provide this item—for example, an offer to sell a product, rent the DVD of a movie, perform a service, or give away tickets to an event. Use [[businessFunction]] to indicate the kind of transaction offered, i.e. sell, lease, etc. This property can also be used to describe a [[Demand]]. While this property is listed as expected on a number of common types, it can be used in others. In that case, using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

terms.label: offersPrescriptionByMail
terms.definition: Whether prescriptions can be delivered by mail.

terms.label: openingHours
terms.definition: The general opening hours for a business. Opening hours can be specified as a weekly time range, starting with days, then times per day. Multiple days can be listed with commas ',' separating each day. Day or time ranges are specified using a hyphen '-'. * Days are specified using the following two-letter combinations: ```Mo```, ```Tu```, ```We```, ```Th```, ```Fr```, ```Sa```, ```Su```. * Times are specified using 24:00 format. For example, 3pm is specified as ```15:00```, 10am as ```10:00```. * Here is an example: <time itemprop="openingHours" datetime="Tu,Th 16:00-20:00">Tuesdays and Thursdays 4-8pm</time>. * If a business is open 7 days a week, then it can be specified as <time itemprop="openingHours" datetime="Mo-Su">Monday through Sunday, all day</time>.

terms.label: openingHoursSpecification
terms.definition: The opening hours of a certain place.

terms.label: opens
terms.definition: The opening hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

terms.label: operatingSystem
terms.definition: Operating systems supported (Windows 7, OS X 10.6, Android 1.6).

terms.label: opponent
terms.definition: A sub property of participant. The opponent on this action.

terms.label: option
terms.definition: A sub property of object. The options subject to this action.

terms.label: orderDate
terms.definition: Date order was placed.

terms.label: orderDelivery
terms.definition: The delivery of the parcel related to this order or order item.

terms.label: orderItemNumber
terms.definition: The identifier of the order item.

terms.label: orderItemStatus
terms.definition: The current status of the order item.

terms.label: orderNumber
terms.definition: The identifier of the transaction.

terms.label: orderPercentage
terms.definition: Value representing the fraction of the value of the order that is charged as shipping cost. Example: 0.10 would mean shipping rate is 10% of the total order value.

terms.label: orderQuantity
terms.definition: The number of the item ordered. If the property is not set, assume the quantity is one.

terms.label: orderStatus
terms.definition: The current status of the order.

terms.label: orderValue
terms.definition: Minimum and maximum order value for which these shipping conditions are valid.

terms.label: orderedItem
terms.definition: The item ordered.

terms.label: organizer
terms.definition: An organizer of an Event.

terms.label: originAddress
terms.definition: Shipper's address.

terms.label: originalMediaContextDescription
terms.definition: Describes, in a [[MediaReview]] when dealing with [[DecontextualizedContent]], background information that can contribute to better interpretation of the [[MediaObject]].

terms.label: originalMediaLink
terms.definition: Link to the page containing an original version of the content, or directly to an online copy of the original [[MediaObject]] content, e.g. video file.

terms.label: originatesFrom
terms.definition: The vasculature the lymphatic structure originates, or afferents, from.

terms.label: overdosage
terms.definition: Any information related to overdose on a drug, including signs or symptoms, treatments, contact information for emergency response.

terms.label: ownedFrom
terms.definition: The date and time of obtaining the product.

terms.label: ownedThrough
terms.definition: The date and time of giving up ownership on the product.

terms.label: owner
terms.definition: A person or organization who owns this Thing.

terms.label: ownershipFundingInfo
terms.definition: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a description of organizational ownership structure; funding and grants. In a news/media setting, this is with particular reference to editorial independence. Note that the [[funder]] is also available and can be used to make basic funder information machine-readable.

terms.label: owns
terms.definition: Things owned by the organization or person.

terms.label: pageEnd
terms.definition: The page on which the work ends; for example "138" or "xvi".

terms.label: pageStart
terms.definition: The page on which the work starts; for example "135" or "xiii".

terms.label: pagination
terms.definition: Any description of pages that is not separated into pageStart and pageEnd; for example, "1-6, 9, 55" or "10-12, 46-49".

terms.label: parent
terms.definition: A parent of this person.

terms.label: parentItem
terms.definition: The parent of a question, answer or item in general. Typically used for Q/A discussion threads e.g. a chain of comments with the first comment being an [[Article]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. See also [[comment]] which points from something to a comment about it.

terms.label: parentOrganization
terms.definition: The larger organization that this organization is a [[subOrganization]] of, if any.

terms.label: parentService
terms.definition: A broadcast service to which the broadcast service may belong to such as regional variations of a national channel.

terms.label: parentTaxon
terms.definition: Closest parent taxon of the taxon in question.

terms.label: parents
terms.definition: A parents of the person.

terms.label: partOfEpisode
terms.definition: The episode to which this clip belongs.

terms.label: partOfInvoice
terms.definition: The order is being paid as part of the referenced Invoice.

terms.label: partOfOrder
terms.definition: The overall order the items in this delivery were included in.

terms.label: partOfSeason
terms.definition: The season to which this episode belongs.

terms.label: partOfSeries
terms.definition: The series to which this episode or season belongs.

terms.label: partOfSystem
terms.definition: The anatomical or organ system that this structure is part of.

terms.label: partOfTVSeries
terms.definition: The TV series to which this episode or season belongs.

terms.label: partOfTrip
terms.definition: Identifies that this [[Trip]] is a subTrip of another Trip. For example Day 1, Day 2, etc. of a multi-day trip.

terms.label: participant
terms.definition: Other co-agents that participated in the action indirectly. E.g. John wrote a book with *Steve*.

terms.label: partySize
terms.definition: Number of people the reservation should accommodate.

terms.label: passengerPriorityStatus
terms.definition: The priority status assigned to a passenger for security or boarding (e.g. FastTrack or Priority).

terms.label: passengerSequenceNumber
terms.definition: The passenger's sequence number as assigned by the airline.

terms.label: pathophysiology
terms.definition: Changes in the normal mechanical, physical, and biochemical functions that are associated with this activity or condition.

terms.label: pattern
terms.definition: A pattern that something has, for example 'polka dot', 'striped', 'Canadian flag'. Values are typically expressed as text, although links to controlled value schemes are also supported.

terms.label: payload
terms.definition:
The permitted weight of passengers and cargo, EXCLUDING the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: Many databases specify the permitted TOTAL weight instead, which is the sum of [[weight]] and [[payload]]
* Note 2: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 3: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 4: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: paymentAccepted
terms.definition: Cash, Credit Card, Cryptocurrency, Local Exchange Tradings System, etc.

terms.label: paymentDue
terms.definition: The date that payment is due.

terms.label: paymentDueDate
terms.definition: The date that payment is due.

terms.label: paymentMethod
terms.definition: The name of the credit card or other method of payment for the order.

terms.label: paymentMethodId
terms.definition: An identifier for the method of payment used (e.g. the last 4 digits of the credit card).

terms.label: paymentMethodType
terms.definition: The type of a payment method.

terms.label: paymentStatus
terms.definition: The status of payment; whether the invoice has been paid or not.

terms.label: paymentUrl
terms.definition: The URL for sending a payment.

terms.label: penciler
terms.definition: The individual who draws the primary narrative artwork.

terms.label: percentile10
terms.definition: The 10th percentile value.

terms.label: percentile25
terms.definition: The 25th percentile value.

terms.label: percentile75
terms.definition: The 75th percentile value.

terms.label: percentile90
terms.definition: The 90th percentile value.

terms.label: performTime
terms.definition: The length of time it takes to perform instructions or a direction (not including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

terms.label: performer
terms.definition: A performer at the event—for example, a presenter, musician, musical group or actor.

terms.label: performerIn
terms.definition: Event that this person is a performer or participant in.

terms.label: performers
terms.definition: The main performer or performers of the event—for example, a presenter, musician, or actor.

terms.label: permissionType
terms.definition: The type of permission granted the person, organization, or audience.

terms.label: permissions
terms.definition: Permission(s) required to run the app (for example, a mobile app may require full internet access or may run only on wifi).

terms.label: permitAudience
terms.definition: The target audience for this permit.

terms.label: permittedUsage
terms.definition: Indications regarding the permitted usage of the accommodation.

terms.label: petsAllowed
terms.definition: Indicates whether pets are allowed to enter the accommodation or lodging business. More detailed information can be put in a text value.

terms.label: phoneticText
terms.definition: Representation of a text [[textValue]] using the specified [[speechToTextMarkup]]. For example the city name of Houston in IPA: /ˈhjuːstən/.

terms.label: photo
terms.definition: A photograph of this place.

terms.label: photos
terms.definition: Photographs of this place.

terms.label: physicalRequirement
terms.definition: A description of the types of physical activity associated with the job. Defined terms such as those in O*net may be used, but note that there is no way to specify the level of ability as well as its nature when using a defined term.

terms.label: physiologicalBenefits
terms.definition: Specific physiologic benefits associated to the plan.

terms.label: pickupLocation
terms.definition: Where a taxi will pick up a passenger or a rental car can be picked up.

terms.label: pickupTime
terms.definition: When a taxi will pick up a passenger or a rental car can be picked up.

terms.label: playMode
terms.definition: Indicates whether this game is multi-player, co-op or single-player. The game can be marked as multi-player, co-op and single-player at the same time.

terms.label: playerType
terms.definition: Player type required—for example, Flash or Silverlight.

terms.label: playersOnline
terms.definition: Number of players on the server.

terms.label: polygon
terms.definition: A polygon is the area enclosed by a point-to-point path for which the starting and ending points are the same. A polygon is expressed as a series of four or more space delimited points where the first and final points are identical.

terms.label: populationType
terms.definition: Indicates the populationType common to all members of a [[StatisticalPopulation]] or all cases within the scope of a [[StatisticalVariable]].

terms.label: position
terms.definition: The position of an item in a series or sequence of items.

terms.label: positiveNotes
terms.definition: Provides positive considerations regarding something, for example product highlights or (alongside [[negativeNotes]]) pro/con lists for reviews. In the case of a [[Review]], the property describes the [[itemReviewed]] from the perspective of the review; in the case of a [[Product]], the product itself is being described. The property values can be expressed either as unstructured text (repeated as necessary), or if ordered, as a list (in which case the most positive is at the beginning of the list).

terms.label: possibleComplication
terms.definition: A possible unexpected and unfavorable evolution of a medical condition. Complications may include worsening of the signs or symptoms of the disease, extension of the condition to other organ systems, etc.

terms.label: possibleTreatment
terms.definition: A possible treatment to address this condition, sign or symptom.

terms.label: postOfficeBoxNumber
terms.definition: The post office box number for PO box addresses.

terms.label: postOp
terms.definition: A description of the postoperative procedures, care, and/or followups for this device.

terms.label: postalCode
terms.definition: The postal code. For example, 94043.

terms.label: postalCodeBegin
terms.definition: First postal code in a range (included).

terms.label: postalCodeEnd
terms.definition: Last postal code in the range (included). Needs to be after [[postalCodeBegin]].

terms.label: postalCodePrefix
terms.definition: A defined range of postal codes indicated by a common textual prefix. Used for non-numeric systems such as UK.

terms.label: postalCodeRange
terms.definition: A defined range of postal codes.

terms.label: potentialAction
terms.definition: Indicates a potential Action, which describes an idealized action in which this thing would play an 'object' role.

terms.label: potentialUse
terms.definition: Intended use of the BioChemEntity by humans.

terms.label: practicesAt
terms.definition: A [[MedicalOrganization]] where the [[IndividualPhysician]] practices.

terms.label: preOp
terms.definition: A description of the workup, testing, and other preparations required before implanting this device.

terms.label: predecessorOf
terms.definition: A pointer from a previous, often discontinued variant of the product to its newer variant.

terms.label: pregnancyCategory
terms.definition: Pregnancy category of this drug.

terms.label: pregnancyWarning
terms.definition: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use during pregnancy.

terms.label: prepTime
terms.definition: The length of time it takes to prepare the items to be used in instructions or a direction, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

terms.label: preparation
terms.definition: Typical preparation that a patient must undergo before having the procedure performed.

terms.label: prescribingInfo
terms.definition: Link to prescribing information for the drug.

terms.label: prescriptionStatus
terms.definition: Indicates the status of drug prescription, e.g. local catalogs classifications or whether the drug is available by prescription or over-the-counter, etc.

terms.label: previousItem
terms.definition: A link to the ListItem that precedes the current one.

terms.label: previousStartDate
terms.definition: Used in conjunction with eventStatus for rescheduled or cancelled events. This property contains the previously scheduled start date. For rescheduled events, the startDate property should be used for the newly scheduled start date. In the (rare) case of an event that has been postponed and rescheduled multiple times, this field may be repeated.

terms.label: price
terms.definition:
The offer price of a product, or of a price component when attached to PriceSpecification and its subtypes.

Usage guidelines:

* Use the [[priceCurrency]] property (with standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR") instead of including [ambiguous symbols](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dollar_sign#Currencies_that_use_the_dollar_or_peso_sign) such as '$' in the value.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.
* Note that both [RDFa](http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml-rdfa-primer/#using-the-content-attribute) and Microdata syntax allow the use of a "content=" attribute for publishing simple machine-readable values alongside more human-friendly formatting.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.

terms.label: priceComponent
terms.definition: This property links to all [[UnitPriceSpecification]] nodes that apply in parallel for the [[CompoundPriceSpecification]] node.

terms.label: priceComponentType
terms.definition: Identifies a price component (for example, a line item on an invoice), part of the total price for an offer.

terms.label: priceCurrency
terms.definition: The currency of the price, or a price component when attached to [[PriceSpecification]] and its subtypes.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

terms.label: priceRange
terms.definition: The price range of the business, for example ```$$$```.

terms.label: priceSpecification
terms.definition: One or more detailed price specifications, indicating the unit price and delivery or payment charges.

terms.label: priceType
terms.definition: Defines the type of a price specified for an offered product, for example a list price, a (temporary) sale price or a manufacturer suggested retail price. If multiple prices are specified for an offer the [[priceType]] property can be used to identify the type of each such specified price. The value of priceType can be specified as a value from enumeration PriceTypeEnumeration or, a UN/EDIFACT 5387 code, or as a free form text string for price types that are not already predefined in PriceTypeEnumeration.

terms.label: priceValidUntil
terms.definition: The date after which the price is no longer available.

terms.label: primaryImageOfPage
terms.definition: Indicates the main image on the page.

terms.label: primaryPrevention
terms.definition: A preventative therapy used to prevent an initial occurrence of the medical condition, such as vaccination.

terms.label: printColumn
terms.definition: The number of the column in which the NewsArticle appears in the print edition.

terms.label: printEdition
terms.definition: The edition of the print product in which the NewsArticle appears.

terms.label: printPage
terms.definition: If this NewsArticle appears in print, this field indicates the name of the page on which the article is found. Please note that this field is intended for the exact page name (e.g. A5, B18).

terms.label: printSection
terms.definition: If this NewsArticle appears in print, this field indicates the print section in which the article appeared.

terms.label: procedure
terms.definition: A description of the procedure involved in setting up, using, and/or installing the device.

terms.label: procedureType
terms.definition: The type of procedure, for example Surgical, Noninvasive, or Percutaneous.

terms.label: processingTime
terms.definition: Estimated processing time for the service using this channel.

terms.label: processorRequirements
terms.definition: Processor architecture required to run the application (e.g. IA64).

terms.label: producer
terms.definition: The person or organization who produced the work (e.g. music album, movie, TV/radio series etc.).

terms.label: produces
terms.definition: The tangible thing generated by the service, e.g. a passport, permit, etc.

terms.label: productGroupID
terms.definition: Indicates a textual identifier for a ProductGroup.

terms.label: productID
terms.definition: The product identifier, such as ISBN. For example: ``` meta itemprop="productID" content="isbn:123-456-789" ```.

terms.label: productReturnDays
terms.definition: The productReturnDays property indicates the number of days (from purchase) within which relevant product return policy is applicable.

terms.label: productReturnLink
terms.definition: Indicates a Web page or service by URL, for product return.

terms.label: productSupported
terms.definition: The product or service this support contact point is related to (such as product support for a particular product line). This can be a specific product or product line (e.g. "iPhone") or a general category of products or services (e.g. "smartphones").

terms.label: productionCompany
terms.definition: The production company or studio responsible for the item, e.g. series, video game, episode etc.

terms.label: productionDate
terms.definition: The date of production of the item, e.g. vehicle.

terms.label: proficiencyLevel
terms.definition: Proficiency needed for this content; expected values: 'Beginner', 'Expert'.

terms.label: program
terms.definition: The [MemberProgram](https://schema.org/MemberProgram) associated with a [ProgramMembership](https://schema.org/ProgramMembership).

terms.label: programMembershipUsed
terms.definition: Any membership in a frequent flyer, hotel loyalty program, etc. being applied to the reservation.

terms.label: programName
terms.definition: The program providing the membership. It is preferable to use [:program](https://schema.org/program) instead.

terms.label: programPrerequisites
terms.definition: Prerequisites for enrolling in the program.

terms.label: programType
terms.definition: The type of educational or occupational program. For example, classroom, internship, alternance, etc.

terms.label: programmingLanguage
terms.definition: The computer programming language.

terms.label: programmingModel
terms.definition: Indicates whether API is managed or unmanaged.

terms.label: pronouns
terms.definition: A short string listing or describing pronouns for a person. Typically the person concerned is the best authority as pronouns are a critical part of personal identity and expression. Publishers and consumers of this information are reminded to treat this data responsibly, take country-specific laws related to gender expression into account, and be wary of out-of-date data and drawing unwarranted inferences about the person being described. In English, formulations such as "they/them", "she/her", and "he/him" are commonly used online and can also be used here. We do not intend to enumerate all possible micro-syntaxes in all languages. More structured and well-defined external values for pronouns can be referenced using the [[StructuredValue]] or [[DefinedTerm]] values.

terms.label: propertyID
terms.definition: A commonly used identifier for the characteristic represented by the property, e.g. a manufacturer or a standard code for a property. propertyID can be (1) a prefixed string, mainly meant to be used with standards for product properties; (2) a site-specific, non-prefixed string (e.g. the primary key of the property or the vendor-specific ID of the property), or (3) a URL indicating the type of the property, either pointing to an external vocabulary, or a Web resource that describes the property (e.g. a glossary entry). Standards bodies should promote a standard prefix for the identifiers of properties from their standards.

terms.label: proprietaryName
terms.definition: Proprietary name given to the diet plan, typically by its originator or creator.

terms.label: proteinContent
terms.definition: The number of grams of protein.

terms.label: provider
terms.definition: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.

terms.label: providerMobility
terms.definition: Indicates the mobility of a provided service (e.g. 'static', 'dynamic').

terms.label: providesBroadcastService
terms.definition: The BroadcastService offered on this channel.

terms.label: providesService
terms.definition: The service provided by this channel.

terms.label: publicAccess
terms.definition: A flag to signal that the [[Place]] is open to public visitors. If this property is omitted there is no assumed default boolean value.

terms.label: publicTransportClosuresInfo
terms.definition: Information about public transport closures.

terms.label: publication
terms.definition: A publication event associated with the item.

terms.label: publicationType
terms.definition: The type of the medical article, taken from the US NLM MeSH publication type catalog. See also [MeSH documentation](http://www.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/pubtypes.html).

terms.label: publishedBy
terms.definition: An agent associated with the publication event.

terms.label: publishedOn
terms.definition: A broadcast service associated with the publication event.

terms.label: publisher
terms.definition: The publisher of the article in question.

terms.label: publisherImprint
terms.definition: The publishing division which published the comic.

terms.label: publishingPrinciples
terms.definition: The publishingPrinciples property indicates (typically via [[URL]]) a document describing the editorial principles of an [[Organization]] (or individual, e.g. a [[Person]] writing a blog) that relate to their activities as a publisher, e.g. ethics or diversity policies. When applied to a [[CreativeWork]] (e.g. [[NewsArticle]]) the principles are those of the party primarily responsible for the creation of the [[CreativeWork]]. While such policies are most typically expressed in natural language, sometimes related information (e.g. indicating a [[funder]]) can be expressed using schema.org terminology.

terms.label: purchaseDate
terms.definition: The date the item, e.g. vehicle, was purchased by the current owner.

terms.label: purchasePriceLimit
terms.definition: Optional. The maximum price the item can have and still qualify for this offer.

terms.label: purchaseType
terms.definition: Optional. The type of purchase the consumer must make in order to qualify for this incentive.

terms.label: qualifications
terms.definition: Specific qualifications required for this role or Occupation.

terms.label: qualifiedExpense
terms.definition: Optional. The types of expenses that are covered by the incentive. For example some incentives are only for the goods (tangible items) but the services (labor) are excluded.

terms.label: quarantineGuidelines
terms.definition: Guidelines about quarantine rules, e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

terms.label: query
terms.definition: A sub property of instrument. The query used on this action.

terms.label: quest
terms.definition: The task that a player-controlled character, or group of characters may complete in order to gain a reward.

terms.label: question
terms.definition: A sub property of object. A question.

terms.label: rangeIncludes
terms.definition: Relates a property to a class that constitutes (one of) the expected type(s) for values of the property.

terms.label: ratingCount
terms.definition: The count of total number of ratings.

terms.label: ratingExplanation
terms.definition: A short explanation (e.g. one to two sentences) providing background context and other information that led to the conclusion expressed in the rating. This is particularly applicable to ratings associated with "fact check" markup using [[ClaimReview]].

terms.label: ratingValue
terms.definition:
The rating for the content.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

terms.label: readBy
terms.definition: A person who reads (performs) the audiobook.

terms.label: readonlyValue
terms.definition: Whether or not a property is mutable. Default is false. Specifying this for a property that also has a value makes it act similar to a "hidden" input in an HTML form.

terms.label: realEstateAgent
terms.definition: A sub property of participant. The real estate agent involved in the action.

terms.label: recipe
terms.definition: A sub property of instrument. The recipe/instructions used to perform the action.

terms.label: recipeCategory
terms.definition: The category of the recipe—for example, appetizer, entree, etc.

terms.label: recipeCuisine
terms.definition: The cuisine of the recipe (for example, French or Ethiopian).

terms.label: recipeIngredient
terms.definition: An ingredient or ordered list of ingredients and potentially quantities used in the recipe, e.g. 1 cup of sugar, flour or garlic. The ingredients can be represented as free text or more structured values.

terms.label: recipeInstructions
terms.definition: A step in making the recipe, in the form of a single item (document, video, etc.) or an ordered list with HowToStep and/or HowToSection items.

terms.label: recipeYield
terms.definition: The quantity produced by the recipe (for example, number of people served, number of servings, etc).

terms.label: recipient
terms.definition: A sub property of participant. The participant who is at the receiving end of the action.

terms.label: recognizedBy
terms.definition: An organization that acknowledges the validity, value or utility of a credential. Note: recognition may include a process of quality assurance or accreditation.

terms.label: recognizingAuthority
terms.definition: If applicable, the organization that officially recognizes this entity as part of its endorsed system of medicine.

terms.label: recommendationStrength
terms.definition: Strength of the guideline's recommendation (e.g. 'class I').

terms.label: recommendedIntake
terms.definition: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.

terms.label: recordLabel
terms.definition: The label that issued the release.

terms.label: recordedAs
terms.definition: An audio recording of the work.

terms.label: recordedAt
terms.definition: The Event where the CreativeWork was recorded. The CreativeWork may capture all or part of the event.

terms.label: recordedIn
terms.definition: The CreativeWork that captured all or part of this Event.

terms.label: recordingOf
terms.definition: The composition this track is a recording of.

terms.label: recourseLoan
terms.definition: The only way you get the money back in the event of default is the security. Recourse is where you still have the opportunity to go back to the borrower for the rest of the money.

terms.label: recycledContentPercentage
terms.definition: The percentage of recycled material in the product.

terms.label: referee
terms.definition: An official who watches a game or match closely to enforce the rules and arbitrate on matters arising from the play such as referees, umpires or judges. The name of the effective function can vary according to the sport.

terms.label: referenceQuantity
terms.definition: The reference quantity for which a certain price applies, e.g. 1 EUR per 4 kWh of electricity. This property is a replacement for unitOfMeasurement for the advanced cases where the price does not relate to a standard unit.

terms.label: referencesOrder
terms.definition: The Order(s) related to this Invoice. One or more Orders may be combined into a single Invoice.

terms.label: refundType
terms.definition: A refund type, from an enumerated list.

terms.label: regionDrained
terms.definition: The anatomical or organ system drained by this vessel; generally refers to a specific part of an organ.

terms.label: regionsAllowed
terms.definition: The regions where the media is allowed. If not specified, then it's assumed to be allowed everywhere. Specify the countries in [ISO 3166 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166).

terms.label: relatedAnatomy
terms.definition: Anatomical systems or structures that relate to the superficial anatomy.

terms.label: relatedCondition
terms.definition: A medical condition associated with this anatomy.

terms.label: relatedDrug
terms.definition: Any other drug related to this one, for example commonly-prescribed alternatives.

terms.label: relatedLink
terms.definition: A link related to this web page, for example to other related web pages.

terms.label: relatedStructure
terms.definition: Related anatomical structure(s) that are not part of the system but relate or connect to it, such as vascular bundles associated with an organ system.

terms.label: relatedTherapy
terms.definition: A medical therapy related to this anatomy.

terms.label: relatedTo
terms.definition: The most generic familial relation.

terms.label: releaseDate
terms.definition: The release date of a product or product model. This can be used to distinguish the exact variant of a product.

terms.label: releaseNotes
terms.definition: Description of what changed in this version.

terms.label: releaseOf
terms.definition: The album this is a release of.

terms.label: releasedEvent
terms.definition: The place and time the release was issued, expressed as a PublicationEvent.

terms.label: relevantOccupation
terms.definition: The Occupation for the JobPosting.

terms.label: relevantSpecialty
terms.definition: If applicable, a medical specialty in which this entity is relevant.

terms.label: remainingAttendeeCapacity
terms.definition: The number of attendee places for an event that remain unallocated.

terms.label: renegotiableLoan
terms.definition: Whether the terms for payment of interest can be renegotiated during the life of the loan.

terms.label: repeatCount
terms.definition: Defines the number of times a recurring [[Event]] will take place.

terms.label: repeatFrequency
terms.definition: Defines the frequency at which [[Event]]s will occur according to a schedule [[Schedule]]. The intervals between events should be defined as a [[Duration]] of time.

terms.label: repetitions
terms.definition: Number of times one should repeat the activity.

terms.label: replacee
terms.definition: A sub property of object. The object that is being replaced.

terms.label: replacer
terms.definition: A sub property of object. The object that replaces.

terms.label: replyToUrl
terms.definition: The URL at which a reply may be posted to the specified UserComment.

terms.label: reportNumber
terms.definition: The number or other unique designator assigned to a Report by the publishing organization.

terms.label: representativeOfPage
terms.definition: Indicates whether this image is representative of the content of the page.

terms.label: requiredCollateral
terms.definition: Assets required to secure loan or credit repayments. It may take form of third party pledge, goods, financial instruments (cash, securities, etc.)

terms.label: requiredGender
terms.definition: Audiences defined by a person's gender.

terms.label: requiredMaxAge
terms.definition: Audiences defined by a person's maximum age.

terms.label: requiredMinAge
terms.definition: Audiences defined by a person's minimum age.

terms.label: requiredQuantity
terms.definition: The required quantity of the item(s).

terms.label: requirements
terms.definition: Component dependency requirements for application. This includes runtime environments and shared libraries that are not included in the application distribution package, but required to run the application (examples: DirectX, Java or .NET runtime).

terms.label: requiresSubscription
terms.definition: Indicates if use of the media require a subscription (either paid or free). Allowed values are ```true``` or ```false``` (note that an earlier version had 'yes', 'no').

terms.label: reservationFor
terms.definition: The thing -- flight, event, restaurant, etc. being reserved.

terms.label: reservationId
terms.definition: A unique identifier for the reservation.

terms.label: reservationStatus
terms.definition: The current status of the reservation.

terms.label: reservedTicket
terms.definition: A ticket associated with the reservation.

terms.label: responsibilities
terms.definition: Responsibilities associated with this role or Occupation.

terms.label: restPeriods
terms.definition: How often one should break from the activity.

terms.label: restockingFee
terms.definition: Use [[MonetaryAmount]] to specify a fixed restocking fee for product returns, or use [[Number]] to specify a percentage of the product price paid by the customer.

terms.label: result
terms.definition: The result produced in the action. E.g. John wrote *a book*.

terms.label: resultComment
terms.definition: A sub property of result. The Comment created or sent as a result of this action.

terms.label: resultReview
terms.definition: A sub property of result. The review that resulted in the performing of the action.

terms.label: returnFees
terms.definition: The type of return fees for purchased products (for any return reason).

terms.label: returnLabelSource
terms.definition: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a product returned for any reason.

terms.label: returnMethod
terms.definition: The type of return method offered, specified from an enumeration.

terms.label: returnPolicyCategory
terms.definition: Specifies an applicable return policy (from an enumeration).

terms.label: returnPolicyCountry
terms.definition: The country where the product has to be sent to for returns, for example "Ireland" using the [[name]] property of [[Country]]. You can also provide the two-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1). Note that this can be different from the country where the product was originally shipped from or sent to.

terms.label: returnPolicySeasonalOverride
terms.definition: Seasonal override of a return policy.

terms.label: returnShippingFeesAmount
terms.definition: Amount of shipping costs for product returns (for any reason). Applicable when property [[returnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

terms.label: review
terms.definition: A review of the item.

terms.label: reviewAspect
terms.definition: This Review or Rating is relevant to this part or facet of the itemReviewed.

terms.label: reviewBody
terms.definition: The actual body of the review.

terms.label: reviewCount
terms.definition: The count of total number of reviews.

terms.label: reviewRating
terms.definition: The rating given in this review. Note that reviews can themselves be rated. The ```reviewRating``` applies to rating given by the review. The [[aggregateRating]] property applies to the review itself, as a creative work.

terms.label: reviewedBy
terms.definition: People or organizations that have reviewed the content on this web page for accuracy and/or completeness.

terms.label: reviews
terms.definition: Review of the item.

terms.label: riskFactor
terms.definition: A modifiable or non-modifiable factor that increases the risk of a patient contracting this condition, e.g. age, coexisting condition.

terms.label: risks
terms.definition: Specific physiologic risks associated to the diet plan.

terms.label: roleName
terms.definition: A role played, performed or filled by a person or organization. For example, the team of creators for a comic book might fill the roles named 'inker', 'penciller', and 'letterer'; or an athlete in a SportsTeam might play in the position named 'Quarterback'.

terms.label: roofLoad
terms.definition:
The permitted total weight of cargo and installations (e.g. a roof rack) on top of the vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]]
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: rsvpResponse
terms.definition: The response (yes, no, maybe) to the RSVP.

terms.label: runsTo
terms.definition: The vasculature the lymphatic structure runs, or efferents, to.

terms.label: runtime
terms.definition: Runtime platform or script interpreter dependencies (example: Java v1, Python 2.3, .NET Framework 3.0).

terms.label: runtimePlatform
terms.definition: Runtime platform or script interpreter dependencies (example: Java v1, Python 2.3, .NET Framework 3.0).

terms.label: rxcui
terms.definition: The RxCUI drug identifier from RXNORM.

terms.label: safetyConsideration
terms.definition: Any potential safety concern associated with the supplement. May include interactions with other drugs and foods, pregnancy, breastfeeding, known adverse reactions, and documented efficacy of the supplement.

terms.label: salaryCurrency
terms.definition: The currency (coded using [ISO 4217](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217)) used for the main salary information in this job posting or for this employee.

terms.label: salaryUponCompletion
terms.definition: The expected salary upon completing the training.

terms.label: sameAs
terms.definition: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. E.g. the URL of the item's Wikipedia page, Wikidata entry, or official website.

terms.label: sampleType
terms.definition: What type of code sample: full (compile ready) solution, code snippet, inline code, scripts, template.

terms.label: saturatedFatContent
terms.definition: The number of grams of saturated fat.

terms.label: scheduleTimezone
terms.definition: Indicates the timezone for which the time(s) indicated in the [[Schedule]] are given. The value provided should be among those listed in the IANA Time Zone Database.

terms.label: scheduledPaymentDate
terms.definition: The date the invoice is scheduled to be paid.

terms.label: scheduledTime
terms.definition: The time the object is scheduled to.

terms.label: schemaVersion
terms.definition: Indicates (by URL or string) a particular version of a schema used in some CreativeWork. This property was created primarily to indicate the use of a specific schema.org release, e.g. ```10.0``` as a simple string, or more explicitly via URL, ```https://schema.org/docs/releases.html#v10.0```. There may be situations in which other schemas might usefully be referenced this way, e.g. ```http://dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dces/1999-07-02/``` but this has not been carefully explored in the community.

terms.label: schoolClosuresInfo
terms.definition: Information about school closures.

terms.label: screenCount
terms.definition: The number of screens in the movie theater.

terms.label: screenshot
terms.definition: A link to a screenshot image of the app.

terms.label: sdDatePublished
terms.definition: Indicates the date on which the current structured data was generated / published. Typically used alongside [[sdPublisher]].

terms.label: sdLicense
terms.definition: A license document that applies to this structured data, typically indicated by URL.

terms.label: sdPublisher
terms.definition: Indicates the party responsible for generating and publishing the current structured data markup, typically in cases where the structured data is derived automatically from existing published content but published on a different site. For example, student projects and open data initiatives often re-publish existing content with more explicitly structured metadata. The [[sdPublisher]] property helps make such practices more explicit.

terms.label: season
terms.definition: A season in a media series.

terms.label: seasonNumber
terms.definition: Position of the season within an ordered group of seasons.

terms.label: seasonalOverride
terms.definition: Limited period during which these shipping conditions apply.

terms.label: seasons
terms.definition: A season in a media series.

terms.label: seatNumber
terms.definition: The location of the reserved seat (e.g., 27).

terms.label: seatRow
terms.definition: The row location of the reserved seat (e.g., B).

terms.label: seatSection
terms.definition: The section location of the reserved seat (e.g. Orchestra).

terms.label: seatingCapacity
terms.definition: The number of persons that can be seated (e.g. in a vehicle), both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

terms.label: seatingType
terms.definition: The type/class of the seat.

terms.label: secondaryPrevention
terms.definition: A preventative therapy used to prevent reoccurrence of the medical condition after an initial episode of the condition.

terms.label: securityClearanceRequirement
terms.definition: A description of any security clearance requirements of the job.

terms.label: securityScreening
terms.definition: The type of security screening the passenger is subject to.

terms.label: seeks
terms.definition: A pointer to products or services sought by the organization or person (demand).

terms.label: seller
terms.definition: An entity which offers (sells / leases / lends / loans) the services / goods. A seller may also be a provider.

terms.label: sender
terms.definition: A sub property of participant. The participant who is at the sending end of the action.

terms.label: sensoryRequirement
terms.definition: A description of any sensory requirements and levels necessary to function on the job, including hearing and vision. Defined terms such as those in O*net may be used, but note that there is no way to specify the level of ability as well as its nature when using a defined term.

terms.label: sensoryUnit
terms.definition: The neurological pathway extension that inputs and sends information to the brain or spinal cord.

terms.label: serialNumber
terms.definition: The serial number or any alphanumeric identifier of a particular product. When attached to an offer, it is a shortcut for the serial number of the product included in the offer.

terms.label: seriousAdverseOutcome
terms.definition: A possible serious complication and/or serious side effect of this therapy. Serious adverse outcomes include those that are life-threatening; result in death, disability, or permanent damage; require hospitalization or prolong existing hospitalization; cause congenital anomalies or birth defects; or jeopardize the patient and may require medical or surgical intervention to prevent one of the outcomes in this definition.

terms.label: serverStatus
terms.definition: Status of a game server.

terms.label: servesCuisine
terms.definition: The cuisine of the restaurant.

terms.label: serviceArea
terms.definition: The geographic area where the service is provided.

terms.label: serviceAudience
terms.definition: The audience eligible for this service.

terms.label: serviceLocation
terms.definition: The location (e.g. civic structure, local business, etc.) where a person can go to access the service.

terms.label: serviceOperator
terms.definition: The operating organization, if different from the provider. This enables the representation of services that are provided by an organization, but operated by another organization like a subcontractor.

terms.label: serviceOutput
terms.definition: The tangible thing generated by the service, e.g. a passport, permit, etc.

terms.label: servicePhone
terms.definition: The phone number to use to access the service.

terms.label: servicePostalAddress
terms.definition: The address for accessing the service by mail.

terms.label: serviceSmsNumber
terms.definition: The number to access the service by text message.

terms.label: serviceType
terms.definition: The type of service being offered, e.g. veterans' benefits, emergency relief, etc.

terms.label: serviceUrl
terms.definition: The website to access the service.

terms.label: servingSize
terms.definition: The serving size, in terms of the number of volume or mass.

terms.label: sha256
terms.definition: The [SHA-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-2) SHA256 hash of the content of the item. For example, a zero-length input has value 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'.

terms.label: sharedContent
terms.definition: A CreativeWork such as an image, video, or audio clip shared as part of this posting.

terms.label: shippingConditions
terms.definition: The conditions (constraints, price) applicable to the [[ShippingService]].

terms.label: shippingDestination
terms.definition: indicates (possibly multiple) shipping destinations. These can be defined in several ways, e.g. postalCode ranges.

terms.label: shippingDetails
terms.definition: Indicates information about the shipping policies and options associated with an [[Offer]].

terms.label: shippingLabel
terms.definition: Label to match an [[OfferShippingDetails]] with a [[ShippingRateSettings]] (within the context of a [[shippingSettingsLink]] cross-reference).

terms.label: shippingOrigin
terms.definition: Indicates the origin of a shipment, i.e. where it should be coming from.

terms.label: shippingRate
terms.definition: The shipping rate is the cost of shipping to the specified destination. Typically, the maxValue and currency values (of the [[MonetaryAmount]]) are most appropriate.

terms.label: shippingSettingsLink
terms.definition: Link to a page containing [[ShippingRateSettings]] and [[DeliveryTimeSettings]] details.

terms.label: sibling
terms.definition: A sibling of the person.

terms.label: siblings
terms.definition: A sibling of the person.

terms.label: signDetected
terms.definition: A sign detected by the test.

terms.label: signOrSymptom
terms.definition: A sign or symptom of this condition. Signs are objective or physically observable manifestations of the medical condition while symptoms are the subjective experience of the medical condition.

terms.label: significance
terms.definition: The significance associated with the superficial anatomy; as an example, how characteristics of the superficial anatomy can suggest underlying medical conditions or courses of treatment.

terms.label: significantLink
terms.definition: One of the more significant URLs on the page. Typically, these are the non-navigation links that are clicked on the most.

terms.label: significantLinks
terms.definition: The most significant URLs on the page. Typically, these are the non-navigation links that are clicked on the most.

terms.label: size
terms.definition: A standardized size of a product or creative work, specified either through a simple textual string (for example 'XL', '32Wx34L'), a QuantitativeValue with a unitCode, or a comprehensive and structured [[SizeSpecification]]; in other cases, the [[width]], [[height]], [[depth]] and [[weight]] properties may be more applicable.

terms.label: sizeGroup
terms.definition: The size group (also known as "size type") for a product's size. Size groups are common in the fashion industry to define size segments and suggested audiences for wearable products. Multiple values can be combined, for example "men's big and tall", "petite maternity" or "regular".

terms.label: sizeSystem
terms.definition: The size system used to identify a product's size. Typically either a standard (for example, "GS1" or "ISO-EN13402"), country code (for example "US" or "JP"), or a measuring system (for example "Metric" or "Imperial").

terms.label: skills
terms.definition: A statement of knowledge, skill, ability, task or any other assertion expressing a competency that is either claimed by a person, an organization or desired or required to fulfill a role or to work in an occupation.

terms.label: sku
terms.definition: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU), i.e. a merchant-specific identifier for a product or service, or the product to which the offer refers.

terms.label: slogan
terms.definition: A slogan or motto associated with the item.

terms.label: smiles
terms.definition: A specification in form of a line notation for describing the structure of chemical species using short ASCII strings. Double bond stereochemistry \ indicators may need to be escaped in the string in formats where the backslash is an escape character.

terms.label: smokingAllowed
terms.definition: Indicates whether it is allowed to smoke in the place, e.g. in the restaurant, hotel or hotel room.

terms.label: sodiumContent
terms.definition: The number of milligrams of sodium.

terms.label: softwareAddOn
terms.definition: Additional content for a software application.

terms.label: softwareHelp
terms.definition: Software application help.

terms.label: softwareRequirements
terms.definition: Component dependency requirements for application. This includes runtime environments and shared libraries that are not included in the application distribution package, but required to run the application (examples: DirectX, Java or .NET runtime).

terms.label: softwareVersion
terms.definition: Version of the software instance.

terms.label: source
terms.definition: The source or cause of the event.

terms.label: sourceOrganization
terms.definition: The Organization on whose behalf the creator was working.

terms.label: sourcedFrom
terms.definition: The neurological pathway that originates the neurons.

terms.label: spatial
terms.definition: The "spatial" property can be used in cases when more specific properties (e.g. [[locationCreated]], [[spatialCoverage]], [[contentLocation]]) are not known to be appropriate.

terms.label: spatialCoverage
terms.definition: The spatialCoverage of a CreativeWork indicates the place(s) which are the focus of the content. It is a subproperty of contentLocation intended primarily for more technical and detailed materials. For example with a Dataset, it indicates areas that the dataset describes: a dataset of New York weather would have spatialCoverage which was the place: the state of New York.

terms.label: speakable
terms.definition: Indicates sections of a Web page that are particularly 'speakable' in the sense of being highlighted as being especially appropriate for text-to-speech conversion. Other sections of a page may also be usefully spoken in particular circumstances; the 'speakable' property serves to indicate the parts most likely to be generally useful for speech. The *speakable* property can be repeated an arbitrary number of times, with three kinds of possible 'content-locator' values: 1.) *id-value* URL references - uses *id-value* of an element in the page being annotated. The simplest use of *speakable* has (potentially relative) URL values, referencing identified sections of the document concerned. 2.) CSS Selectors - addresses content in the annotated page, e.g. via class attribute. Use the [[cssSelector]] property. 3.) XPaths - addresses content via XPaths (assuming an XML view of the content). Use the [[xpath]] property. For more sophisticated markup of speakable sections beyond simple ID references, either CSS selectors or XPath expressions to pick out document section(s) as speakable. For this we define a supporting type, [[SpeakableSpecification]] which is defined to be a possible value of the *speakable* property.

terms.label: specialCommitments
terms.definition: Any special commitments associated with this job posting. Valid entries include VeteranCommit, MilitarySpouseCommit, etc.

terms.label: specialOpeningHoursSpecification
terms.definition: The special opening hours of a certain place.\n\nUse this to explicitly override general opening hours brought in scope by [[openingHoursSpecification]] or [[openingHours]].

terms.label: specialty
terms.definition: One of the domain specialities to which this web page's content applies.

terms.label: specification
terms.definition: A specification of the product, often grouped by a section header/name. This is a cleaner alternative to additionalProperty for strict retail product specifications.

terms.label: speechToTextMarkup
terms.definition: Form of markup used. eg. [SSML](https://www.w3.org/TR/speech-synthesis11) or [IPA](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Property:P898).

terms.label: speed
terms.definition:
The speed range of the vehicle. If the vehicle is powered by an engine, the upper limit of the speed range (indicated by [[maxValue]]) should be the maximum speed achievable under regular conditions.

Typical unit code(s): KMH for km/h, HM for mile per hour (0.447 04 m/s), KNT for knot

*Note 1: Use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate the range. Typically, the minimal value is zero.
* Note 2: There are many different ways of measuring the speed range. You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.

terms.label: spokenByCharacter
terms.definition: The (e.g. fictional) character, Person or Organization to whom the quotation is attributed within the containing CreativeWork.

terms.label: sponsor
terms.definition: A person or organization that supports a thing through a pledge, promise, or financial contribution. E.g. a sponsor of a Medical Study or a corporate sponsor of an event.

terms.label: sport
terms.definition: A type of sport (e.g. Baseball).

terms.label: sportsActivityLocation
terms.definition: A sub property of location. The sports activity location where this action occurred.

terms.label: sportsEvent
terms.definition: A sub property of location. The sports event where this action occurred.

terms.label: sportsTeam
terms.definition: A sub property of participant. The sports team that participated on this action.

terms.label: spouse
terms.definition: The person's spouse.

terms.label: stage
terms.definition: The stage of the condition, if applicable.

terms.label: stageAsNumber
terms.definition: The stage represented as a number, e.g. 3.

terms.label: starRating
terms.definition: An official rating for a lodging business or food establishment, e.g. from national associations or standards bodies. Use the author property to indicate the rating organization, e.g. as an Organization with name such as (e.g. HOTREC, DEHOGA, WHR, or Hotelstars).

terms.label: startDate
terms.definition: The start date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

terms.label: startOffset
terms.definition: The start time of the clip expressed as the number of seconds from the beginning of the work.

terms.label: startTime
terms.definition: The startTime of something. For a reserved event or service (e.g. FoodEstablishmentReservation), the time that it is expected to start. For actions that span a period of time, when the action was performed. E.g. John wrote a book from *January* to December. For media, including audio and video, it's the time offset of the start of a clip within a larger file.\n\nNote that Event uses startDate/endDate instead of startTime/endTime, even when describing dates with times. This situation may be clarified in future revisions.

terms.label: statType
terms.definition: Indicates the kind of statistic represented by a [[StatisticalVariable]], e.g. mean, count etc. The value of statType is a property, either from within Schema.org (e.g. [[median]], [[marginOfError]], [[maxValue]], [[minValue]]) or from other compatible (e.g. RDF) systems such as DataCommons.org or Wikidata.org.

terms.label: status
terms.definition: The status of the study (enumerated).

terms.label: steeringPosition
terms.definition: The position of the steering wheel or similar device (mostly for cars).

terms.label: step
terms.definition: A single step item (as HowToStep, text, document, video, etc.) or a HowToSection.

terms.label: stepValue
terms.definition: The stepValue attribute indicates the granularity that is expected (and required) of the value in a PropertyValueSpecification.

terms.label: steps
terms.definition: A single step item (as HowToStep, text, document, video, etc.) or a HowToSection (originally misnamed 'steps'; 'step' is preferred).

terms.label: storageRequirements
terms.definition: Storage requirements (free space required).

terms.label: streetAddress
terms.definition: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

terms.label: strengthUnit
terms.definition: The units of an active ingredient's strength, e.g. mg.

terms.label: strengthValue
terms.definition: The value of an active ingredient's strength, e.g. 325.

terms.label: structuralClass
terms.definition: The name given to how bone physically connects to each other.

terms.label: study
terms.definition: A medical study or trial related to this entity.

terms.label: studyDesign
terms.definition: Specifics about the observational study design (enumerated).

terms.label: studyLocation
terms.definition: The location in which the study is taking/took place.

terms.label: studySubject
terms.definition: A subject of the study, i.e. one of the medical conditions, therapies, devices, drugs, etc. investigated by the study.

terms.label: subEvent
terms.definition: An Event that is part of this event. For example, a conference event includes many presentations, each of which is a subEvent of the conference.

terms.label: subEvents
terms.definition: Events that are a part of this event. For example, a conference event includes many presentations, each subEvents of the conference.

terms.label: subOrganization
terms.definition: A relationship between two organizations where the first includes the second, e.g., as a subsidiary. See also: the more specific 'department' property.

terms.label: subReservation
terms.definition: The individual reservations included in the package. Typically a repeated property.

terms.label: subStageSuffix
terms.definition: The substage, e.g. 'a' for Stage IIIa.

terms.label: subStructure
terms.definition: Component (sub-)structure(s) that comprise this anatomical structure.

terms.label: subTest
terms.definition: A component test of the panel.

terms.label: subTrip
terms.definition: Identifies a [[Trip]] that is a subTrip of this Trip. For example Day 1, Day 2, etc. of a multi-day trip.

terms.label: subjectOf
terms.definition: A CreativeWork or Event about this Thing.

terms.label: substanceOfConcern
terms.definition: A substance of concern (SoC) contained within the product, typically based on regulatory lists like REACH or RoHS.

terms.label: subtitleLanguage
terms.definition: Languages in which subtitles/captions are available, in [IETF BCP 47 standard format](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47).

terms.label: successorOf
terms.definition: A pointer from a newer variant of a product to its previous, often discontinued predecessor.

terms.label: sugarContent
terms.definition: The number of grams of sugar.

terms.label: suggestedAge
terms.definition: The age or age range for the intended audience or person, for example 3-12 months for infants, 1-5 years for toddlers.

terms.label: suggestedAnswer
terms.definition: An answer (possibly one of several, possibly incorrect) to a Question, e.g. on a Question/Answer site.

terms.label: suggestedGender
terms.definition: The suggested gender of the intended person or audience, for example "male", "female", or "unisex".

terms.label: suggestedMaxAge
terms.definition: Maximum recommended age in years for the audience or user.

terms.label: suggestedMeasurement
terms.definition: A suggested range of body measurements for the intended audience or person, for example inseam between 32 and 34 inches or height between 170 and 190 cm. Typically found on a size chart for wearable products.

terms.label: suggestedMinAge
terms.definition: Minimum recommended age in years for the audience or user.

terms.label: suitableForDiet
terms.definition: Indicates a dietary restriction or guideline for which this recipe or menu item is suitable, e.g. diabetic, halal etc.

terms.label: superEvent
terms.definition: An event that this event is a part of. For example, a collection of individual music performances might each have a music festival as their superEvent.

terms.label: supersededBy
terms.definition: Relates a term (i.e. a property, class or enumeration) to one that supersedes it.

terms.label: supply
terms.definition: A sub-property of instrument. A supply consumed when performing instructions or a direction.

terms.label: supplyTo
terms.definition: The area to which the artery supplies blood.

terms.label: supportingData
terms.definition: Supporting data for a SoftwareApplication.

terms.label: surface
terms.definition: A material used as a surface in some artwork, e.g. Canvas, Paper, Wood, Board, etc.

terms.label: syllabusSections
terms.definition: Indicates (typically several) Syllabus entities that lay out what each section of the overall course will cover.

terms.label: target
terms.definition: Indicates a target EntryPoint, or url, for an Action.

terms.label: targetCollection
terms.definition: A sub property of object. The collection target of the action.

terms.label: targetDescription
terms.definition: The description of a node in an established educational framework.

terms.label: targetName
terms.definition: The name of a node in an established educational framework.

terms.label: targetPlatform
terms.definition: Type of app development: phone, Metro style, desktop, XBox, etc.

terms.label: targetPopulation
terms.definition: Characteristics of the population for which this is intended, or which typically uses it, e.g. 'adults'.

terms.label: targetProduct
terms.definition: Target Operating System / Product to which the code applies. If applies to several versions, just the product name can be used.

terms.label: targetUrl
terms.definition: The URL of a node in an established educational framework.

terms.label: taxID
terms.definition: The Tax / Fiscal ID of the organization or person, e.g. the TIN in the US or the CIF/NIF in Spain.

terms.label: taxonRank
terms.definition: The taxonomic rank of this taxon given preferably as a URI from a controlled vocabulary – typically the ranks from TDWG TaxonRank ontology or equivalent Wikidata URIs.

terms.label: taxonomicRange
terms.definition: The taxonomic grouping of the organism that expresses, encodes, or in some way related to the BioChemEntity.

terms.label: teaches
terms.definition: The item being described is intended to help a person learn the competency or learning outcome defined by the referenced term.

terms.label: telephone
terms.definition: The telephone number.

terms.label: temporal
terms.definition: The "temporal" property can be used in cases where more specific properties (e.g. [[temporalCoverage]], [[dateCreated]], [[dateModified]], [[datePublished]]) are not known to be appropriate.

terms.label: temporalCoverage
terms.definition: The temporalCoverage of a CreativeWork indicates the period that the content applies to, i.e. that it describes, either as a DateTime or as a textual string indicating a time period in [ISO 8601 time interval format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Time_intervals). In the case of a Dataset it will typically indicate the relevant time period in a precise notation (e.g. for a 2011 census dataset, the year 2011 would be written "2011/2012"). Other forms of content, e.g. ScholarlyArticle, Book, TVSeries or TVEpisode, may indicate their temporalCoverage in broader terms - textually or via well-known URL. Written works such as books may sometimes have precise temporal coverage too, e.g. a work set in 1939 - 1945 can be indicated in ISO 8601 interval format format via "1939/1945". Open-ended date ranges can be written with ".." in place of the end date. For example, "2015-11/.." indicates a range beginning in November 2015 and with no specified final date. This is tentative and might be updated in future when ISO 8601 is officially updated.

terms.label: termCode
terms.definition: A code that identifies this [[DefinedTerm]] within a [[DefinedTermSet]].

terms.label: termDuration
terms.definition: The amount of time in a term as defined by the institution. A term is a length of time where students take one or more classes. Semesters and quarters are common units for term.

terms.label: termsOfService
terms.definition: Human-readable terms of service documentation.

terms.label: termsPerYear
terms.definition: The number of times terms of study are offered per year. Semesters and quarters are common units for term. For example, if the student can only take 2 semesters for the program in one year, then termsPerYear should be 2.

terms.label: text
terms.definition: The textual content of this CreativeWork.

terms.label: textValue
terms.definition: Text value being annotated.

terms.label: thumbnail
terms.definition: Thumbnail image for an image or video.

terms.label: thumbnailUrl
terms.definition: A thumbnail image relevant to the Thing.

terms.label: tickerSymbol
terms.definition: The exchange traded instrument associated with a Corporation object. The tickerSymbol is expressed as an exchange and an instrument name separated by a space character. For the exchange component of the tickerSymbol attribute, we recommend using the controlled vocabulary of Market Identifier Codes (MIC) specified in ISO 15022.

terms.label: ticketNumber
terms.definition: The unique identifier for the ticket.

terms.label: ticketToken
terms.definition: Reference to an asset (e.g., Barcode, QR code image or PDF) usable for entrance.

terms.label: ticketedSeat
terms.definition: The seat associated with the ticket.

terms.label: timeOfDay
terms.definition: The time of day the program normally runs. For example, "evenings".

terms.label: timeRequired
terms.definition: Approximate or typical time it usually takes to work with or through the content of this work for the typical or target audience.

terms.label: timeToComplete
terms.definition: The expected length of time to complete the program if attending full-time.

terms.label: timestamp
terms.definition: The instant the event occured.

terms.label: tissueSample
terms.definition: The type of tissue sample required for the test.

terms.label: title
terms.definition: The title of the job.

terms.label: titleEIDR
terms.definition: An [EIDR](https://eidr.org/) (Entertainment Identifier Registry) [[identifier]] representing at the most general/abstract level, a work of film or television. For example, the motion picture known as "Ghostbusters" has a titleEIDR of "10.5240/7EC7-228A-510A-053E-CBB8-J". This title (or work) may have several variants, which EIDR calls "edits". See [[editEIDR]].
