Since schema.org types like [[Movie]], [[TVEpisode]], [[TVSeason]], and [[TVSeries]] can be used for both works and their multiple expressions, it is possible to use [[titleEIDR]] alone (for a general description), or alongside [[editEIDR]] for a more edit-specific description.

terms.label: toLocation
terms.definition: A sub property of location. The final location of the object or the agent after the action.

terms.label: toRecipient
terms.definition: A sub property of recipient. The recipient who was directly sent the message.

terms.label: tocContinuation
terms.definition: A [[HyperTocEntry]] can have a [[tocContinuation]] indicated, which is another [[HyperTocEntry]] that would be the default next item to play or render.

terms.label: tocEntry
terms.definition: Indicates a [[HyperTocEntry]] in a [[HyperToc]].

terms.label: tongueWeight
terms.definition:
The permitted vertical load (TWR) of a trailer attached to the vehicle. Also referred to as Tongue Load Rating (TLR) or Vertical Load Rating (VLR).

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: tool
terms.definition: A sub property of instrument. An object used (but not consumed) when performing instructions or a direction.

terms.label: torque
terms.definition:
The torque (turning force) of the vehicle's engine.

Typical unit code(s): NU for newton metre (N m), F17 for pound-force per foot, or F48 for pound-force per inch

* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined (e.g. reference RPM) using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: totalHistoricalEnrollment
terms.definition: The total number of students that have enrolled in the history of the course.

terms.label: totalJobOpenings
terms.definition: The number of positions open for this job posting. Use a positive integer. Do not use if the number of positions is unclear or not known.

terms.label: totalPaymentDue
terms.definition: The total amount due.

terms.label: totalPrice
terms.definition:
The total price for the reservation or ticket, including applicable taxes, shipping, etc.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

terms.label: totalTime
terms.definition: The total time required to perform instructions or a direction (including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

terms.label: tourBookingPage
terms.definition: A page providing information on how to book a tour of some [[Place]], such as an [[Accommodation]] or [[ApartmentComplex]] in a real estate setting, as well as other kinds of tours as appropriate.

terms.label: touristType
terms.definition: Attraction suitable for type(s) of tourist. E.g. children, visitors from a particular country, etc.

terms.label: track
terms.definition: A music recording (track)—usually a single song. If an ItemList is given, the list should contain items of type MusicRecording.

terms.label: trackingNumber
terms.definition: Shipper tracking number.

terms.label: trackingUrl
terms.definition: Tracking url for the parcel delivery.

terms.label: tracks
terms.definition: A music recording (track)—usually a single song.

terms.label: trailer
terms.definition: The trailer of a movie or TV/radio series, season, episode, etc.

terms.label: trailerWeight
terms.definition:
The permitted weight of a trailer attached to the vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound
* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: trainName
terms.definition: The name of the train (e.g. The Orient Express).

terms.label: trainNumber
terms.definition: The unique identifier for the train.

terms.label: trainingSalary
terms.definition: The estimated salary earned while in the program.

terms.label: transFatContent
terms.definition: The number of grams of trans fat.

terms.label: transcript
terms.definition: If this MediaObject is an AudioObject or VideoObject, the transcript of that object.

terms.label: transitTime
terms.definition: The typical delay the order has been sent for delivery and the goods reach the final customer. In the context of [[ShippingDeliveryTime]], use the [[QuantitativeValue]]. Typical properties: minValue, maxValue, unitCode (d for DAY). In the context of [[ShippingConditions]], use the [[ServicePeriod]]. It has a duration (as a [[QuantitativeValue]]) and also business days and a cut-off time.

terms.label: transitTimeLabel
terms.definition: Label to match an [[OfferShippingDetails]] with a [[DeliveryTimeSettings]] (within the context of a [[shippingSettingsLink]] cross-reference).

terms.label: translationOfWork
terms.definition: The work that this work has been translated from. E.g. 物种起源 is a translationOf “On the Origin of Species”.

terms.label: translator
terms.definition: Organization or person who adapts a creative work to different languages, regional differences and technical requirements of a target market, or that translates during some event.

terms.label: transmissionMethod
terms.definition: How the disease spreads, either as a route or vector, for example 'direct contact', 'Aedes aegypti', etc.

terms.label: travelBans
terms.definition: Information about travel bans, e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

terms.label: trialDesign
terms.definition: Specifics about the trial design (enumerated).

terms.label: tributary
terms.definition: The anatomical or organ system that the vein flows into; a larger structure that the vein connects to.

terms.label: tripOrigin
terms.definition: The location of origin of the trip, prior to any destination(s).

terms.label: typeOfBed
terms.definition: The type of bed to which the BedDetail refers, i.e. the type of bed available in the quantity indicated by quantity.

terms.label: typeOfGood
terms.definition: The product that this structured value is referring to.

terms.label: typicalAgeRange
terms.definition: The typical expected age range, e.g. '7-9', '11-'.

terms.label: typicalCreditsPerTerm
terms.definition: The number of credits or units a full-time student would be expected to take in 1 term however 'term' is defined by the institution.

terms.label: typicalTest
terms.definition: A medical test typically performed given this condition.

terms.label: underName
terms.definition: The person or organization the reservation or ticket is for.

terms.label: unitCode
terms.definition: The unit of measurement given using the UN/CEFACT Common Code (3 characters) or a URL. Other codes than the UN/CEFACT Common Code may be used with a prefix followed by a colon.

terms.label: unitText
terms.definition: A string or text indicating the unit of measurement. Useful if you cannot provide a standard unit code for unitCode.

terms.label: unnamedSourcesPolicy
terms.definition: For an [[Organization]] (typically a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a statement about policy on use of unnamed sources and the decision process required.

terms.label: unsaturatedFatContent
terms.definition: The number of grams of unsaturated fat.

terms.label: uploadDate
terms.definition: Date (including time if available) when this media object was uploaded to this site.

terms.label: upvoteCount
terms.definition: The number of upvotes this question, answer or comment has received from the community.

terms.label: url
terms.definition: URL of the item.

terms.label: urlTemplate
terms.definition: An url template (RFC6570) that will be used to construct the target of the execution of the action.

terms.label: usNPI
terms.definition: A National Provider Identifier (NPI) is a unique 10-digit identification number issued to health care providers in the United States by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

terms.label: usageInfo
terms.definition: The schema.org [[usageInfo]] property indicates further information about a [[CreativeWork]]. This property is applicable both to works that are freely available and to those that require payment or other transactions. It can reference additional information, e.g. community expectations on preferred linking and citation conventions, as well as purchasing details. For something that can be commercially licensed, usageInfo can provide detailed, resource-specific information about licensing options. This property can be used alongside the license property which indicates license(s) applicable to some piece of content. The usageInfo property can provide information about other licensing options, e.g. acquiring commercial usage rights for an image that is also available under non-commercial creative commons licenses.

terms.label: usedToDiagnose
terms.definition: A condition the test is used to diagnose.

terms.label: userInteractionCount
terms.definition: The number of interactions for the CreativeWork using the WebSite or SoftwareApplication.

terms.label: usesDevice
terms.definition: Device used to perform the test.

terms.label: usesHealthPlanIdStandard
terms.definition: The standard for interpreting the Plan ID. The preferred is "HIOS". See the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services for more details.

terms.label: utterances
terms.definition: Text of an utterances (spoken words, lyrics etc.) that occurs at a certain section of a media object, represented as a [[HyperTocEntry]].

terms.label: validFor
terms.definition: The duration of validity of a permit or similar thing.

terms.label: validForMemberTier
terms.definition: The membership program tier(s) an Offer (or a PriceSpecification, OfferShippingDetails, or MerchantReturnPolicy under an Offer) is valid for.

terms.label: validFrom
terms.definition: The date when the item becomes valid.

terms.label: validIn
terms.definition: The geographic area where the item is valid. Applies for example to a [[Permit]], a [[Certification]], or an [[EducationalOccupationalCredential]].

terms.label: validThrough
terms.definition: The date after when the item is not valid. For example the end of an offer, salary period, or a period of opening hours.

terms.label: validUntil
terms.definition: The date when the item is no longer valid.

terms.label: value
terms.definition:
The value of a [[QuantitativeValue]] (including [[Observation]]) or property value node.

* For [[QuantitativeValue]] and [[MonetaryAmount]], the recommended type for values is 'Number'.
* For [[PropertyValue]], it can be 'Text', 'Number', 'Boolean', 'StructuredValue' or 'QualitativeValue'.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

terms.label: valueAddedTaxIncluded
terms.definition: Specifies whether the applicable value-added tax (VAT) is included in the price specification or not.

terms.label: valueGroup
terms.definition: A header or section name for grouping related property values.

terms.label: valueMaxLength
terms.definition: Specifies the allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.

terms.label: valueMinLength
terms.definition: Specifies the minimum allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.

terms.label: valueName
terms.definition: Indicates the name of the PropertyValueSpecification to be used in URL templates and form encoding in a manner analogous to HTML's input@name.

terms.label: valuePattern
terms.definition: Specifies a regular expression for testing literal values according to the HTML spec.

terms.label: valueReference
terms.definition: A secondary value that provides additional information on the original value, e.g. a reference temperature or a type of measurement.

terms.label: valueRequired
terms.definition: Whether the property must be filled in to complete the action. Default is false.

terms.label: variableMeasured
terms.definition: The variableMeasured property can indicate (repeated as necessary) the variables that are measured in some dataset, either described as text or as pairs of identifier and description using PropertyValue, or more explicitly as a [[StatisticalVariable]].

terms.label: variantCover
terms.definition: A description of the variant cover for the issue, if the issue is a variant printing. For example, "Bryan Hitch Variant Cover" or "2nd Printing Variant".

terms.label: variesBy
terms.definition: Indicates the property or properties by which the variants in a [[ProductGroup]] vary, e.g. their size, color etc. Schema.org properties can be referenced by their short name e.g. "color"; terms defined elsewhere can be referenced with their URIs. Variant properties can be provided using [[PropertyValue]] instead of plain [[Text]], to allow specification of the values available for a variant property.

terms.label: vatID
terms.definition: The value-added Tax ID of the organization or person with national prefix (for example IT123456789). Can also be described as [[iso6523Code]] with proper prefix.

terms.label: vehicleConfiguration
terms.definition: A short text indicating the configuration of the vehicle, e.g. '5dr hatchback ST 2.5 MT 225 hp' or 'limited edition'.

terms.label: vehicleEngine
terms.definition: Information about the engine or engines of the vehicle.

terms.label: vehicleIdentificationNumber
terms.definition: The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) is a unique serial number used by the automotive industry to identify individual motor vehicles.

terms.label: vehicleInteriorColor
terms.definition: The color or color combination of the interior of the vehicle.

terms.label: vehicleInteriorType
terms.definition: The type or material of the interior of the vehicle (e.g. synthetic fabric, leather, wood, etc.). While most interior types are characterized by the material used, an interior type can also be based on vehicle usage or target audience.

terms.label: vehicleModelDate
terms.definition: The release date of a vehicle model (often used to differentiate versions of the same make and model).

terms.label: vehicleSeatingCapacity
terms.definition: The number of passengers that can be seated in the vehicle, both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

terms.label: vehicleSpecialUsage
terms.definition: Indicates whether the vehicle has been used for special purposes, like commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi. The legislation in many countries requires this information to be revealed when offering a car for sale.

terms.label: vehicleTransmission
terms.definition: The type of component used for transmitting the power from a rotating power source to the wheels or other relevant component(s) ("gearbox" for cars).

terms.label: vendor
terms.definition: 'vendor' is an earlier term for 'seller'.

terms.label: verificationFactCheckingPolicy
terms.definition: Disclosure about verification and fact-checking processes for a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other fact-checking [[Organization]].

terms.label: version
terms.definition: The version of the CreativeWork embodied by a specified resource.

terms.label: video
terms.definition: An embedded video object.

terms.label: videoFormat
terms.definition: The type of screening or video broadcast used (e.g. IMAX, 3D, SD, HD, etc.).

terms.label: videoFrameSize
terms.definition: The frame size of the video.

terms.label: videoQuality
terms.definition: The quality of the video.

terms.label: volumeNumber
terms.definition: Identifies the volume of publication or multi-part work; for example, "iii" or "2".

terms.label: warning
terms.definition: Any FDA or other warnings about the drug (text or URL).

terms.label: warranty
terms.definition: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

terms.label: warrantyPromise
terms.definition: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

terms.label: warrantyScope
terms.definition: The scope of the warranty promise.

terms.label: webCheckinTime
terms.definition: The time when a passenger can check into the flight online.

terms.label: webFeed
terms.definition: The URL for a feed, e.g. associated with a podcast series, blog, or series of date-stamped updates. This is usually RSS or Atom.

terms.label: weight
terms.definition: The weight of the product or person.

terms.label: weightPercentage
terms.definition: Value representing the fraction of the weight that is used to compute the shipping price. Example: 0.10 and a shipping weight of 15kg would add $1.5 to the order price, where the $ is the currency of the order.

terms.label: weightTotal
terms.definition:
The permitted total weight of the loaded vehicle, including passengers and cargo and the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: wheelbase
terms.definition: The distance between the centers of the front and rear wheels.\n\nTypical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet.

terms.label: width
terms.definition: The width of the item.

terms.label: winner
terms.definition: A sub property of participant. The winner of the action.

terms.label: wordCount
terms.definition: The number of words in the text of the CreativeWork such as an Article, Book, etc.

terms.label: workExample
terms.definition: Example/instance/realization/derivation of the concept of this creative work. E.g. the paperback edition, first edition, or e-book.

terms.label: workFeatured
terms.definition: A work featured in some event, e.g. exhibited in an ExhibitionEvent. Specific subproperties are available for workPerformed (e.g. a play), or a workPresented (a Movie at a ScreeningEvent).

terms.label: workHours
terms.definition: The typical working hours for this job (e.g. 1st shift, night shift, 8am-5pm).

terms.label: workLocation
terms.definition: A contact location for a person's place of work.

terms.label: workPerformed
terms.definition: A work performed in some event, for example a play performed in a TheaterEvent.

terms.label: workPresented
terms.definition: The movie presented during this event.

terms.label: workTranslation
terms.definition: A work that is a translation of the content of this work. E.g. 西遊記 has an English workTranslation “Journey to the West”, a German workTranslation “Monkeys Pilgerfahrt” and a Vietnamese translation Tây du ký bình khảo.

terms.label: workload
terms.definition: Quantitative measure of the physiologic output of the exercise; also referred to as energy expenditure.

terms.label: worksFor
terms.definition: Organizations that the person works for.

terms.label: worstRating
terms.definition: The lowest value allowed in this rating system.

terms.label: xpath
terms.definition: An XPath, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

terms.label: yearBuilt
terms.definition: The year an [[Accommodation]] was constructed. This corresponds to the [YearBuilt field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/YearBuilt+Field).

terms.label: yearlyRevenue
terms.definition: The size of the business in annual revenue.

terms.label: yearsInOperation
terms.definition: The age of the business.

terms.label: yield
terms.definition: The quantity that results by performing instructions. For example, a paper airplane, 10 personalized candles.
